jobs.title: Senior manager - Sensory & Consumer Insights
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About us:**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations. Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other. Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world. With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships. It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Senior Manager, Sensory Science**
Diageo India Bangalore Research & Development
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Sensory strategy and governance:**
Define sensory strategy, protocols, standards and governance across innovation, renovation, quality and commercialization.
  
  
**Sensory study design:**
Design fit-for-purpose sensory studies for product development, benchmarking, quality, claims and consumer understanding.
  
  

* Panel leadership: Recruit, train, calibrate and manage expert sensory panels; establish panel performance monitoring and accreditation.

**Innovation support:**
Translate sensory and consumer insights into product design direction for aroma, taste, mouthfeel, balance, aftertaste and overall experience.
  
  
**Consumer and flavour intelligence:**
Integrate consumer insights, market trends, launched products, food-service inspirations and expert inputs into innovation pipelines.
  
  
**Quality and manufacturing support:**
Support sensory quality governance, first batch approvals, specifications, investigations and corrective actions across units.
  
  
**Claims substantiation:**
Design evidence to support sensory claims such as smoothness, refreshment, taste superiority, flavour notes and differentiation.
  
  

* Digital and analytics: Drive use of digital sensory platforms, dashboards, automated reporting and AI-enabled insight tools.

**SENSORY EXPERTISE REQUIRED**


* Descriptive Analysis / QDA, consensus profiling and product benchmarking. Discrimination testing: Triangle, Duo-Trio, Tetrad, Paired Comparison, A-not-A and similarity testing.
* JAR, Penalty Analysis, CATA/RATA, preference mapping and drivers of liking.
* Threshold studies: detection, recognition and JND; sensory shelf-life and product matching.
* Panel performance assessment, repeatability, reproducibility, agreement analysis and training design.
* Strong understanding of flavour chemistry, ingredient functionality, aroma-taste interactions and mouthfeel.

**STATISTICAL AND DIGITAL CAPABILITY**


* Strong working knowledge of ANOVA, Mixed Models, PCA, PLS, Cluster Analysis, DOE, Penalty Analysis and Preference Mapping.
* Ability to convert complex sensory and consumer data into clear business recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as XLSTAT, JMP, R, SPSS, Compusense, RedJade, EyeQuestion or equivalent platforms.
* Comfort with data visualization, dashboards, automated analysis and AI-enabled insights tools.

**QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**
**Education:**
Master's or PhD in Sensory Science, Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Consumer Science, Statistics or related discipline.
  
  
**Experience:**
6-8 years in Sensory Science, Product Development, Flavour Science or related R&D roles.
  
  
**Industry background:**
Beverages, alcohol, spirits, RTDs, flavours, food, FMCG or consumer products preferred.
  
  
**Panel experience:**
Proven experience in building, managing and governing expert sensory panels in innovation and quality contexts.
  
  
**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and consumer-centric mindset with strong scientific rigour.
* Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across R&D, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory and external partners.
* Strong communication, storytelling and ability to simplify data for leadership decisions.
* High ownership, accountability, result orientation and comfort working through ambiguity.
* Coaching mindset with the ability to build capability across R&D, Quality and manufacturing teams.
* Curiosity for flavours, consumers, culture, product trends and emerging technologies.

**EXTERNAL AND INTERNAL INTERFACES**
**Internal:**
R&D, Product Development, Innovation, Marketing, Quality, Supply, Regulatory, Legal, Procurement, Commercial and manufacturing units.
  
  

* External: Flavour houses, sensory and consumer research agencies, fermentation experts, ingredient suppliers, universities, start-ups, mixologists and brand ambassadors.

**SUCCESS MEASURES**


* Sensory insights influencing key innovation, renovation and quality decisions. Consumer-preferred and differentiated products delivered to market.
* Strong sensory panel capability and governance across R&D and manufacturing units.
* Faster, more confident product development and commercialization decisions.
* Robust sensory evidence for claims and product communication.
* Improved sensory consistency across manufacturing sites.
* Successful adoption of digital sensory systems, dashboards and analytics.

**Working with us**
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.Ready to bring your best This could be your opportunity.
  
  
*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*
**Recruitment Scam Warning**
*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

Regular

jobs.title: Assistanat Manager - Research And Development
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Research & Development (R&D)**

**Company:**
Deconstruct

**Location:**
Bangalore – HSR Layout

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**About Deconstruct**

We’re a D2C skincare brand built on one belief: safe, sensible, honest skincare. No fairy-tale marketing. No filler ingredients. Just actives that work. We’re looking for an execution-focused, scientifically rigorous
**Assistant Manager – R&D**
who can own our innovation pipeline end to end, from formulation and claims to quality and launch, and help build science-backed skincare that delivers real results.

**What you’ll own**

* Own the end-to-end NPD and renovation pipeline and deliver
  **10–12 new product launches a year**
  on time against the product launch calendar.
* Lead formulation development for new launches and existing SKU renovations, from ingredient evaluation and optimization through compatibility studies to the final formula.
* Ensure seamless pilot batches and commercial scale-ups with third-party manufacturers, with zero RM- or PM-related challenges.
* Ensure every product meets its accelerated stability, freeze-thaw, compatibility and long-term stability requirements, and maintain
  **zero critical consumer complaints**
  across launched products.
* Develop all products within the target cost in the product brief, and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Lead
  **claims substantiation**
  across existing SKUs and at brand level. This includes planning and running efficacy, consumer perception and in-vitro/clinical studies with testing partners, and extending claims in line with brand and NPD goals.
* Explore and develop
  **potential RM blends**
  with ingredient suppliers to build product differentiation.
* Turn technical and claims data into consumer-relevant communication for Brand, Marketing and Customer Service teams.
* Deliver technical content for PDPs, social media campaigns, blogs, label artworks and marketing communications.
* Own
  **GRN approvals**
  for raw materials within TAT, and work with Quality to keep incoming material standards high.
* Run weekly cross-functional reviews with Brand, CS, Supply Chain, Procurement, Packaging, Quality and Regulatory, as well as with RM and FG vendors, to deliver OTIF.
* Maintain and update NPD project trackers, ensure no deviation from standard SOPs, and drive continuous improvement in development processes.
* Manage formulation partners, CDMOs and ingredient suppliers, and evaluate new vendors and technologies.
* Guide and review the work of R&D associates and interns, and support their technical growth.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, formulation records and product specifications, and support regulatory and artwork approvals.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cosmetic Technology, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in skincare, cosmetics, personal care or pharmaceutical formulation development.
* A proven track record of taking multiple products from brief to commercial launch with third-party manufacturers.
* Strong expertise in emulsion systems, active ingredients, stability testing, scale-up and commercialization.
* Hands-on exposure to claims substantiation, including efficacy studies, testing labs and claim support documentation.
* Ability to manage a high-volume NPD pipeline in parallel without compromising timelines, quality or cost.
* Strong vendor management, project management and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Ability to explain complex science in clear, consumer-friendly language.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is an advantage.
* Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate.

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and experience.
* **Growth:**
  Ownership of the brand’s innovation pipeline, working directly with leadership and cross-functional teams on products from concept to launch.
* **Culture:**
  A fast-paced, collaborative, science-driven and ownership-focused environment with plenty of room to learn, innovate and grow.

**ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION**

* Experience in D2C skincare, beauty, cosmetics or FMCG brands is preferred.
* Experience running claims substantiation or clinical/efficacy studies is highly desirable.
* Exposure to BIS/CDSCO cosmetic regulations and claim compliance will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a strong passion for skincare innovation, emerging ingredients and consumer-centric product development will be given preference.

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
Hiring: Head Chef – Arabian Cuisine & Product Development (R&D)

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5+ years preferred

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and passionate
**Arabian Cuisine Chef**
, preferably with expertise in traditional Middle Eastern cooking and Arabic bread preparation, to join our team.

This is a specialised culinary development role focused on creating authentic recipes, developing new menu items, standardising food preparation processes and building comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for our restaurant operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Arabian cuisine, an understanding of traditional cooking techniques and the ability to translate culinary expertise into standardised, repeatable processes that can be implemented across multiple restaurant outlets.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Recipe Development & Menu Innovation**

* Develop authentic Arabian and Middle Eastern recipes.
* Create and refine recipes for Mandi, grilled meats, Alfaham, Shawarma, BBQ, kebabs, marinades, sauces, dips and other Arabian specialities.
* Experiment with ingredients, spices, cooking techniques and flavour profiles.
* Develop new menu items while maintaining authenticity and consistency.
* Conduct food trials, tasting sessions and product evaluations.

**2. Arabic Bread & Bakery Specialisation**

* Develop recipes and preparation methods for traditional Arabic breads.
* Expertise in Khubz, Pita, Saj, Khameer, Tannour and other Middle Eastern breads is highly desirable.
* Standardise dough preparation, fermentation, proofing, baking temperatures and cooking techniques.
* Establish consistent bread quality, texture, thickness and shelf life.

**3. SOP Development & Standardisation**

* Create detailed recipe documentation with exact ingredient quantities and preparation procedures.
* Develop step-by-step SOPs for food preparation, cooking, storage and handling.
* Establish standard portion sizes, cooking times, temperatures and plating specifications.
* Develop batch preparation methods for commercial kitchen operations.
* Ensure recipes are scalable and consistently reproducible across multiple outlets.

**4. Kitchen Training & Implementation**

* Train kitchen staff on newly developed recipes and preparation techniques.
* Demonstrate standardised cooking procedures.
* Establish quality control and consistency benchmarks.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs within kitchen operations.

**5. Food Costing & Quality Control**

* Assist in ingredient selection and sourcing.
* Develop recipes with commercial viability and cost efficiency in mind.
* Calculate recipe yields, portion costs and wastage.
* Maintain consistency in taste, presentation and product quality.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of professional culinary experience preferred.
* Strong specialisation in Arabian, Middle Eastern or Gulf cuisine.
* Previous experience working in Gulf countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman or Bahrain) is highly preferred.
* Strong expertise in traditional Arabic bread making is an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in recipe development and menu creation.
* Ability to document recipes and create structured kitchen SOPs.
* Experience training and managing kitchen teams.
* Good understanding of commercial kitchen operations, food costing and standardisation.

Who We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in chefs who understand the difference between simply preparing food and developing a consistent, commercially scalable food product.

The candidate should be passionate about authentic Arabian cuisine, detail-oriented, experimental and capable of building structured culinary systems from the ground up.

**Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on Gulf culinary experience and expertise in both Arabian cuisine and Arabic bread preparation.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their resume along with details of their culinary specialisation, previous experience and examples of recipes or menus they have developed.

* **We look forward to working with someone who can bring authentic Arabian flavours and professional culinary systems to our growing restaurant business.**

jobs.title: Design Team Leader - Bakery, Bars & Confectionery
Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**Reporting to:**
Director; working closely with Production, R&D, Purchase, Stores, Engineering, Fulfilment and Finance

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Location:**
CC Manufacturing Unit, Bangalore (Onsite)

**Experience:**
6+ years in Quality Assurance / Food Safety, including at least 2 years in a managerial role

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday

**CTC:**
Up to ₹10 LPA + Benefits

**Role Purpose**

To lead and take overall responsibility for Quality Assurance, Food Safety and Quality Management Systems at CC Pet Foods, ensuring that all manufactured products consistently meet defined quality, nutritional, safety, regulatory and customer requirements.

He/ she will establish and drive a preventive, process-oriented quality culture across raw material sourcing, manufacturing, packaging, storage and dispatch.

The role is accountable for developing robust quality systems, managing the QA team, ensuring regulatory compliance, preventing product failures and driving the company's First Time Right and Zero Compromise on Food Safety philosophy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Own, implement and continuously improve the factory-wide Quality Management System (QMS).
* Develop and enforce SOPs, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), HACCP plans and food safety controls.
* Lead implementation, certification and maintenance of ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 or equivalent food safety management systems.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian regulatory requirements, relevant BIS standards, customer specifications and internal quality policies.
* Establish quality policies, inspection standards, testing protocols and acceptance criteria across manufacturing operations.
* Lead internal, external, customer and certification audits, ensuring timely closure of non-conformities.
* Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready quality documentation.

**2. Raw Material & Supplier Quality Management**

* Establish quality specifications and acceptance standards for meat, poultry, fish, organs, vegetables, grains, flours, oils, supplements, additives and packaging materials.
* Own incoming material inspection, testing, acceptance, rejection and quarantine procedures.
* Ensure compliance with approved specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COA), temperature requirements and other quality parameters.
* Lead supplier quality qualification, evaluation, audits and performance improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with Purchase and Stores to address supplier quality issues and establish corrective actions.
* Ensure material traceability, proper storage conditions and FIFO/FEFO compliance.
* Develop risk-based inspection and sampling plans for critical raw materials.

**3. Manufacturing Process Quality Assurance**

* Own in-process quality assurance across wet food, baked products and dehydrated treats manufacturing.
* Establish and monitor critical quality parameters and process controls across weighing, mixing, cooking, baking, dehydration, cooling, filling and packaging.
* Ensure manufacturing compliance with approved formulations, process specifications and batch records.
* Monitor and validate critical process parameters including time, temperature, moisture, water activity, product weight and packaging integrity.
* Establish preventive controls against cross-contamination, foreign-body contamination and process deviations.
* Lead investigations into manufacturing non-conformities and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Work with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce rejection and achieve First Time Right production.

**4. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation**

* Take overall responsibility for factory hygiene, sanitation and food safety standards.
* Establish and monitor personnel hygiene, cleaning, sanitation and environmental monitoring programmes.
* Ensure effective hygiene zoning and segregation of raw, semi-processed and finished products.
* Oversee cleaning verification, ATP testing, environmental swabbing and microbiological monitoring.
* Monitor pest control, waste handling, water quality and other environmental conditions affecting food safety.
* Lead food safety risk assessments and ensure timely mitigation of identified hazards.
* Conduct periodic GMP and hygiene audits across production, storage and utility areas.

**5. Finished Product Quality & Batch Release**

* Own finished product quality standards and release procedures.
* Ensure appropriate physical, chemical, microbiological and sensory testing before product release.
* Establish product specifications for nutritional composition, moisture, water activity, packaging integrity, net weight, appearance and shelf life.
* Review batch manufacturing records, process deviations and quality testing results.
* Exercise authority to approve, hold, reject or release finished product batches based on defined quality and food safety criteria.
* Ensure effective management of non-conforming products, retention samples and product stability studies.
* Oversee packaging quality, seal integrity, batch coding, labelling and traceability compliance.

6. Laboratory & Quality Testing Management

* Manage internal quality laboratories and coordinate testing with approved external laboratories.
* Establish testing plans for raw materials, in-process samples, environmental samples and finished products.
* Oversee microbiological, chemical, physical and nutritional quality testing.
* Ensure laboratory equipment calibration, maintenance, method verification and testing accuracy.
* Review laboratory reports, investigate out-of-specification results and approve corrective actions.
* Establish laboratory testing budgets, consumable requirements and equipment procurement plans.
* Work closely with R&D on formulation validation, shelf-life studies and new product development.

**7. Quality Documentation, Traceability & CAPA**

* Establish and maintain robust documentation and record-control systems.
* Ensure end-to-end batch traceability from raw material receipt through manufacturing and dispatch.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product defects, contamination risks and quality failures.
* Conduct root cause analysis and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Establish product withdrawal and recall procedures and conduct periodic mock recall exercises.
* Maintain quality dashboards, deviation records, audit findings and management review reports.
* Ensure all quality records are complete, accurate and readily available for audits.

**8. Continuous Improvement & Quality Performance**

* Define, monitor and report quality KPIs to senior management.
* Lead initiatives to reduce rejection, rework, process losses, customer complaints and cost of poor quality.
* Identify recurring process deviations and implement preventive improvements.
* Participate in equipment commissioning, process validation, new product trials and manufacturing scale-up.
* Collaborate with Production, R&D, Engineering and Procurement to improve product consistency and manufacturing efficiency.
* Promote data-driven quality decisions and continuous improvement across departments.

**9. QA Team Leadership & Department Management**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams.
* Define department structure, responsibilities, manpower requirements and shift coverage.
* Set performance objectives, review team performance and develop technical capabilities.
* Establish training programmes covering GMP, HACCP, hygiene, quality inspection, documentation and food safety.
* Manage the QA department budget, laboratory expenses and quality-related resources.
* Build a culture of accountability, integrity, disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
* Ensure independent and objective quality decisions, including escalation of critical food safety risks to management.

High school Maths Resource Person-1,

  

High school Chemistry Resource Person-1

  

**Segment:** Primary/High school  
**Location:** Bengaluru, R T Nagar

The role involves academic content development, lesson planning, teacher training, assessment design, and monitoring classroom implementation to ensure consistent academic standards across branches.

The candidate should possess strong subject knowledge, pedagogical expertise, and the ability to translate curriculum objectives into effective teaching-learning practices aligned with CBSE guidelines, NEP 2020, and the National Curriculum Framework (NCF).

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Curriculum Development & Academic Planning**

* Develop and review centralized curriculum frameworks, annual academic plans, and subject-wise syllabi for Grades 15.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for professionals with experience in **healthcare payer operations, transformation, technology, and analytics** to support payer modernization initiatives. The role will focus on improving operational effectiveness, redesigning workflows and operating models, leveraging data and analytics, and supporting technology-enabled transformation across payer functions.

Candidates may specialize in one or more of the following capability areas:

* Healthcare Back Office Transformation

* Support strategic, operational, and technology-led transformation initiatives across healthcare payer organizations.

**Essential Knowledge & Experience**

* Ability to conduct independent research and translate findings into actionable insights.

**Preferred Knowledge & Experience**

* Understanding of **Medicare Advantage, Medicare Part D, Medicaid, and commercial payer models**.

* Experience analyzing large and complex datasets.
* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to perform benchmarking and basic cost-benefit analysis.
* Basic proficiency in GenAI-enabled research and insight development.

  

**Preferred**

* SQL
* Python or R
* Automation tools
* AI/ML and NLP concepts
* Predictive modeling and forecasting
* Healthcare analytics and data visualization
* GenAI-based research and storyboarding

**Core Competencies**

* Strategic and structured thinking
* Strong analytical mindset
* Problem solving
* Stakeholder communication
* Independent research
* Business and technology alignment
* Data-driven decision making
* Innovation and continuous improvement
* Ability to operate effectively in transformation environments

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate combines **healthcare payer domain knowledge with strong analytical and transformation capabilities**. They should be comfortable understanding payer workflows, analyzing complex information and datasets, identifying improvement opportunities, and supporting technology- and data-enabled modernization initiatives.

Candidates with deeper specialization in **payer operations, Medicare/Medicaid, PBM, risk adjustment, care/utilization management, healthcare analytics, data strategy, or payer technology transformation** would be particularly relevant depending on the specific capability area.

jobs.title: Maintenance Executive - Retail
jobs.description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015by Abhay Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being Indias most successful D2Cfood-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac customers with our de-*licious*fresh meat and seafood!

Think you have what it takes to be the **magic ingredient** in the recipe that is Licious? Read on

  

**What makes the role meaty?**

To ensure smooth and uninterrupted maintenance operations across Licious offline retail stores by managing preventive and breakdown maintenance, vendor coordination, infrastructure upkeep, equipment reliability and statutory safety compliance.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Store Maintenance & Operations**

* Manage day-to-day maintenance activities across 8–10 offline retail stores.
* Ensure the availability and proper functioning of refrigeration equipment, display chillers, deep freezers, HVAC, exhaust systems, electrical panels, UPS, RO systems and other store utilities.
* Handle breakdowns and ensure timely resolution to minimise business disruption.
* Conduct regular store visits and maintenance audits to identify and resolve infrastructure issues.

**B. Preventive & Breakdown Maintenance**

* Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules for all store equipment.
* Monitor equipment performance and maintain service history.
* Ensure timely closure of maintenance complaints within defined TAT and SLA.
* Identify recurring equipment failures and implement permanent corrective actions.

**C. Vendor & AMC Management**

* Coordinate with service providers and contractors for maintenance activities.
* Manage AMC, repair quotations, vendor performance and service quality.
* Ensure cost-effective maintenance without compromising equipment reliability.
* Verify vendor bills and validate completed maintenance work before processing payments.

**D. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with electrical safety, fire safety and other statutory requirements.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and maintain audit documentation.
* Ensure proper upkeep of electrical installations, fire extinguishers, emergency lighting and safety equipment.

**E. Cost & Performance Management**

* Monitor store-wise maintenance expenditure and control R&M costs.
* Identify opportunities for energy savings and equipment optimisation.
* Maintain maintenance MIS, breakdown reports, PM compliance and expenditure tracking.
* Drive continuous improvement through 5S, Kaizen and root cause analysis.

  
  

**We hope that you have..**

  

* Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.
* 5–8 years of experience in maintenance and facilities management.
* Experience in retail stores, supermarkets, QSR or food industry preferred.
* Good knowledge of refrigeration, display chillers, deep freezers, HVAC and electrical systems.
* Strong vendor management, troubleshooting and coordination skills.
* Knowledge of CMMS, preventive maintenance and maintenance MIS.
* Good communication and reporting skills.
* Must be willing to travel extensively within the city to manage multiple outlets.
* Preventive maintenance compliance: 95% or above.
* Maintenance complaint closure within defined TAT: 90% or above.
* Equipment uptime and business continuity.
* Reduction in recurring breakdowns.
* Maintenance expenditure within approved budget.
* Vendor SLA and AMC compliance.
* Timely completion of store maintenance audits.
* Improvement in energy efficiency and maintenance cost savings.

Job Purpose

To drive sustainable and profitable growth of the assigned product portfolio through market-led portfolio strategy, customer

insight, product development, lifecycle management, pricing, go-to-market execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

The role is responsible for identifying market opportunities and portfolio gaps, developing differentiated customer value

propositions, building product roadmaps, managing new product development and launches, improving portfolio

profitability, and ensuring products remain competitive and relevant throughout their lifecycle.

Collaborate with Sales, R&D, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, Marketing, Procurement, Legal, Service, and

other relevant stakeholders to translate customer and business requirements into commercially successful products and

solutions.

- Geographic, channel, customer, distributor, dealer, retailer, and influencer coverage, as applicable.

- Product availability, inventory health, service levels, quality, complaints, and customer adoption.

- Product development, research, communication, training, and market-development budgets.

- Portfolio rationalisation, SKU productivity, and product master-data accuracy.

  

4. Key Result Areas and Accountabilities

A. Product and Portfolio Strategy

priorities.

capability.

jobs.title: VP R&D Injectable Products
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

Off Targets Research is building a pipeline of differentiated, complex injectable products for regulated markets, developed through the 505(b)(2) and complex-generic routes and out-licensed to commercial partners. The Vice President R&D, Formulation Development (Injectables) will own formulation and process development end to end, from product feasibility to technology transfer and regulatory submission.

This is an executive role. You will set the technical strategy for the function, decide which products and formulation approaches the company pursues, hold the function accountable for timelines, quality and regulatory success, and represent Off Targets technically with partners, CDMOs and regulators. You will remain close to the science and will lead from technical depth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy and portfolio**

* Define the formulation development strategy for the complex injectable portfolio, including suspensions and nanosuspensions, emulsions, liposomal and lipid-based systems, lyophilised products, ready-to-use solutions and depot / long-acting injectables.
* Assess the technical feasibility, risk and commercial attractiveness of new product opportunities, and advise the CEO and Board on which to pursue, delay or drop.
* Design formulation approaches that are patent-aware and non-infringing, working with IP counsel on freedom-to-operate and carve-out strategy.
* Own the development plan, milestones and budget for the function, and report progress and risks to the CEO and Board.

**Technical leadership and execution**

* Lead preformulation, prototype development, optimisation, scale-up and exhibit batch execution for assigned programmes, either directly or through senior scientists.
* Apply QbD and risk-based approaches (CQAs, CPPs, DoE, control strategy) to formulation design, process understanding and troubleshooting.
* Resolve the hardest formulation and process problems, including stability failures, particle size and polymorph control, precipitation, injectability, reconstitution behaviour and process robustness.
* Make sound sterilisation and manufacturing-route decisions (aseptic, terminal, filtration, lyophilisation, container closure) and understand their effect on product quality and regulatory risk.
* Oversee technology transfer to pilot and commercial manufacturing sites and CDMOs, and challenge their execution where needed.

**Regulatory, quality and CMC**

* Own the formulation and process development sections of regulatory filings (including 3.2.P.2) and the scientific justification behind them, and lead responses to regulatory queries.
* Work with Analytical R&D, QA and Regulatory Affairs to align methods, specifications, characterisation, in-vitro performance testing and stability programmes.

**Commercial and partner engagement**

* Lead the technical side of out-licensing, co-development and contract development discussions, including due diligence responses and partner presentations.
* Build and maintain relationships with CDMOs, CROs, technology providers and external experts.

**People and capability**

* Build, lead and mentor the formulation team, including senior scientists and managers, and develop the next level of leaders.
* Set the culture of the function: scientific rigour, accountability, speed and a bias for solving problems at the root.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Ph.D. in Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Sciences or a related discipline (strongly preferred), or M.Pharm / M.S. with an exceptional track record.

**Experience (must have)**

* 25 or more years in pharmaceutical R&D, with at least 20 years in injectable or sterile product development.
* A record of taking injectable products through to regulatory submission and approval in the US, preferably through 505(b)(2) or complex-generic routes.
* Hands-on depth in at least two complex dosage forms from: suspensions or nanosuspensions, emulsions, liposomal or lipid-based systems, lyophilised products, depot or long-acting injectables.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with patent landscapes and non-infringing formulation design.
* Exposure to licensing, partnering or technical due diligence.

**Leadership attributes**

* Technical authority that earns the respect of scientists and partners.
* Strong judgement under uncertainty, and the courage to give the CEO and Board a straight view.
* Clear written and spoken communication with senior stakeholders and external partners.
* High ownership, urgency and accountability for delivery.

**Why Join Off Targets**

* A senior role with direct access to the Chairman and CEO and real influence on which products the company develops.

jobs.title: AM - Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To lead and manage the complete Quality Assurance and Quality Control function of a high-precision aerospace CNC manufacturing facility, ensuring compliance with AS9100D Rev. D, ISO 9001:2015, aerospace customer requirements, engineering drawings and applicable industry standards.

The candidate must possess strong practical experience in aerospace quality management systems, APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, Gauge R&R, CMM inspection, GD&T, AS9102 First Article Inspection, special process control and aerospace customer quality management.

The individual should be capable of independently handling customer quality audits, technical discussions, quality escalations and approval requirements.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Aerospace Quality Management System AS9100D Rev. D**

* Establish, implement, maintain and continuously improve AS9100D Rev. D Quality Management System.
* Ensure effective implementation of ISO 9001:2015 requirements.
* Prepare and maintain Quality Manual, procedures, work instructions and quality records.
* Plan and conduct internal quality audits and process audits.
* Coordinate external certification audits, surveillance audits and customer audits.
* Manage NCR, CAPA, corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure risk-based thinking, operational risk management and continual improvement.
* Ensure compliance with aerospace customer-specific quality requirements.
* Monitor effectiveness of the Quality Management System.

**B. APQP – Advanced Product Quality Planning**

* Lead APQP activities for new aerospace product development.
* Prepare and review Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* Prepare and implement Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA).
* Develop and implement Control Plans.
* Prepare Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).
* Establish quality planning and inspection requirements for new components.
* Coordinate with Production and Engineering for process validation.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality planning during NPI.
* Review and approve quality documentation before production release.

**C. MSA – Measurement System Analysis and Gauge R&R**

* Strong practical knowledge of Measurement System Analysis (MSA).
* Conduct and review Gauge R&R studies covering repeatability and reproducibility.
* Evaluate measurement system capability and suitability.
* Establish calibration and verification systems for measuring instruments.
* Understand measurement uncertainty, accuracy, precision and traceability.
* Ensure appropriate measuring instruments are selected for critical aerospace dimensions.
* Maintain calibration records and measuring instrument registers.
* Establish measurement system control for CMM and other precision inspection equipment.

**D. Dimensional Inspection and Advanced Metrology**

Must have strong practical knowledge of:

* CMM operation, programming and inspection methodology.
* Contour measuring instruments.
* Profile projectors.
* Height gauges, bore gauges and precision micrometers.
* Roundness and surface roughness measuring instruments.
* Digital and specialised precision measuring equipment.
* Calibration and measurement traceability.
* GD&T and complex engineering drawing interpretation.
* Datum structures, true position, profile, concentricity, runout and geometric tolerances.

Ensure inspection planning, first-off inspection, in-process inspection and final inspection of aerospace components.

**E. CNC Machining Quality and Process Inspection**

Experience in quality control and inspection of:

* CNC turning components.
* Twin-spindle CNC turn-mill components.
* 3-axis, 4-axis and 5-axis CNC milled components.
* CNC VTL components.
* Wire-Cut EDM components.
* Complex precision aerospace components with tight dimensional tolerances.

Ensure dimensional inspection reports are reviewed against customer drawings, specifications and approved inspection requirements.

**F. Aerospace Special Process Quality Management**

* Strong understanding of aerospace special process requirements.
* Control and monitor in-house and outsourced special processes.
* Experience with heat treatment, anodising, chemical conversion coating, plating, passivation and protective coatings.
* Knowledge of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) processes such as FPI, MPI, UT and radiography.
* Review special process certificates, test reports and process qualification records.
* Ensure compliance with applicable aerospace specifications and customer requirements.
* Coordinate special process supplier audits and approval requirements.
* Knowledge of NADCAP accreditation and special process supplier management will be a strong advantage.

**G. Aerospace Quality Documentation and First Article Inspection**

* Preparation and review of AS9102 First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR).
* Preparation and maintenance of APQP documentation.
* Process Flow Diagrams (PFD).
* PFMEA and Control Plans.
* Inspection and Test Plans (ITP).
* MSA and Gauge R&R reports.
* Dimensional inspection and CMM reports.
* Material traceability records and material test certificates.
* Special process certificates and qualification records.
* Non-Conformance Reports (NCR).
* Corrective Action Reports (CAR) and 8D reports.
* Calibration and measurement system records.
* Customer-specific quality documentation and approval records.

**H. Quality Tools and Continuous Improvement**

* Strong knowledge of 7 QC Tools.
* Statistical Process Control (SPC).
* Process Capability Analysis (Cp, Cpk, Pp and Ppk).
* Root Cause Analysis using 5 Why and Fishbone.
* 8D Problem Solving.
* Risk Management and FMEA.
* Continuous improvement and defect prevention.
* Supplier Quality Management and supplier development.
* Reduction of internal and customer rejection.

**I. Supplier Quality Management**

* Monitor and improve supplier quality performance.
* Conduct supplier quality audits and process evaluations.
* Ensure raw material certifications and material traceability.
* Monitor outsourced special process suppliers.
* Handle supplier non-conformities and corrective actions.
* Ensure supplier compliance with aerospace customer requirements.
* Maintain approved supplier documentation and performance records.

**J. Aerospace Customer Handling and Quality Management**

* Strong experience in direct customer quality interactions with aerospace OEMs and Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers.
* Independently handle customer quality audits, quality reviews and technical discussions.
* Handle customer complaints, NCRs, corrective actions and 8D reports.
* Coordinate customer FAI approvals and dimensional inspection documentation.
* Respond to customer queries related to GD&T, CMM, MSA, Gauge R&R, material traceability and special processes.
* Manage customer quality escalations and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.
* Coordinate customer visits and represent the organisation during quality meetings.
* Ensure customer-specific quality requirements are understood and implemented across departments.

**Preferred Aerospace Customer Exposure:**

Airbus, Boeing, Honeywell Aerospace, GE Aerospace, Safran, Rolls-Royce, Pratt & Whitney, ISRO and HAL.

Experience working with their approved Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers will also be considered.

**K. Quality Team Management and Training**

* Lead and manage quality engineers, inspectors, CMM programmers and metrology personnel.
* Develop departmental responsibilities and competency matrices.
* Conduct training on AS9100D, GD&T, CMM, APQP, PFMEA, MSA and inspection methods.
* Develop employee technical competency and inspection skills.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality procedures across production and engineering.

.

**3. PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Experience in aerospace, defence or high-precision manufacturing quality.
* Strong hands-on experience in AS9100D Rev. D implementation.
* Practical knowledge of APQP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA and Gauge R&R.
* Strong CMM, GD&T and precision metrology experience.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Biocompatibility & Toxicology
jobs.description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. 
  
  
**Your Role at Baxter**
Baxter’s Front Line Care business unit develops innovative solutions that help clinicians monitor and manage chronic and acute respiratory and cardiac conditions, improving patient outcomes and quality of life. The Principal Engineer, Toxicology & Biocompatibility serves as the subject matter expert for biocompatibility and toxicological safety across the Front-Line Care portfolio, including patient monitors, cardiology devices, vision care products, respiratory systems, non-invasive ventilation (NIV) devices, masks, breathing circuits, tubing, humidification systems, and accessories.
  
  
This role is responsible for developing toxicology strategies, conducting risk assessments, supporting regulatory submissions, and partnering with cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle. The position is based in Bangalore and reports to the Manager, Systems Front-Line Care.
  
  
**What you'll be doing**

* Lead biocompatibility and toxicology activities across Front Line Care products in accordance with global regulatory and quality requirements.
* Independently develop and execute Biological Evaluation Plans (BEPs) and Biological Evaluation Reports (BERs) in compliance with ISO 10993-1.
* Author, review, and approve Toxicological Risk Assessments (TRAs) in accordance with ISO 10993-17.
* Evaluate chemical safety risks associated with device materials, manufacturing processes, and intended use conditions.
* Collaborate with laboratory partners and cross-functional stakeholders on material characterization programs per ISO 10993-18.
* Serve as the toxicology lead for respiratory and non-invasive ventilation products, including masks, breathing circuits, tubing, connectors, and humidification systems.
* Assess inhalation exposure risks and evaluate the impact of heat, moisture, airflow, volatile compounds, and long-term off-gassing in respiratory devices in accordance with ISO 18562.
* Assess risks associated with cleaning, disinfection, and reprocessing residues on medical devices.
* Support material selection decisions and supplier qualification activities from a toxicological and biocompatibility perspective.
* Provide toxicology expertise for FDA submissions, EU MDR Technical Documentation, and global regulatory filings.
* Act as the primary toxicology representative during regulatory interactions and audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable standards including ISO 10993, ISO 14971, and relevant global regulatory requirements.
* Partner with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and Materials Engineering teams to guide product development decisions.
* Evaluate the toxicological impact of design, process, material, and supplier changes throughout the product lifecycle.
* Drive risk-based decision making and provide scientifically sound recommendations to support product safety and regulatory compliance.

**What you'll bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Biomedical Engineering, or a related scientific discipline. Advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in toxicology, biocompatibility, or biological safety assessments within the medical device industry.
* Strong hands-on experience performing biocompatibility evaluations in accordance with ISO 10993 standards.
* Direct experience with respiratory device evaluations and requirements outlined in ISO 18562.
* Demonstrated expertise in assessing inhalation and respiratory exposure risks.
* Experience supporting FDA, EU MDR, and global regulatory submissions.
* Proven ability to independently develop biological safety strategies and execute complex toxicological assessments.
* Strong understanding of risk management principles and application of ISO 14971.
* Experience identifying toxicological risks early in product development and implementing appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Ability to develop efficient, scientifically justified, and regulatory-defensible testing strategies.
* Demonstrated success in supporting regulatory approvals without biocompatibility-related delays.
* Strong technical influence and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams.
* Experience working with suppliers, external laboratories, and third-party partners.
* Working knowledge of FDA regulations, international medical device standards, and product development processes.
* Understanding of the design, development, and manufacturing of electromechanical medical devices and systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality results within project timelines.
* Self-motivated professional with excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to drive results in a fast-paced, quality-focused medical device environment.

jobs.description:
**We’re hiring |**
Experienced
**Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer**

**Knoxx Foods Australia · Bengaluru (Bangalore)**

This role is based in Bengaluru and requires frequent travel to partner factories across India and willingness to travel overseas when required.

Knoxx Foods develops ingredients and meal components for Australian food manufacturers, including shelf-stable rice and pulses, dry blends and coatings. We’re looking for someone who has managed production at third-party food factories and can represent Knoxx on the factory floor. You’ll oversee how our products are made, how our formulations are protected and whether each order leaves the factory on time and in full.

**What you’ll do**

* **Manage production at partner factories.**
  Agree schedules for trials and commercial runs, confirm raw material and line availability, and track output and yields. When a run falls behind, agree a recovery plan with the factory and follow it through.
* **Verify product and process quality.**
  Conduct frequent site audits to assess facilities, testing capabilities and production practices. Observe live runs to verify that operators follow approved standard operating procedures (SOPs). Check batch records, traceability and test results against Knoxx specifications, then verify that corrective actions work.
* **Protect Knoxx’s intellectual property.**
  Before sharing formulations, process instructions or customer specifications, verify that each factory has confidentiality and access controls in place. During audits, check who can access the information, how printed and electronic copies are controlled, and whether obsolete versions have been withdrawn. Escalate suspected breaches and follow corrective actions through to closure.
* **Plan packaging ahead of every run.**
  Work backwards from the dispatch date to determine when approved pouches, labels and cartons must reach the factory. Confirm quantities, stock and supplier lead times, then track orders through receipt so shortages can be resolved before packing begins.
* **Optimise packaging.**
  Trial pouch sizes, carton configurations and pallet layouts with factories, suppliers and Knoxx R&D. Assess product protection, packing-line performance, waste, cost and container utilisation before recommending changes.
* **Ensure timely factory dispatch.**
  Confirm finished quantities, labels, packing lists, QA release status and freight collection against the committed date. Track each order until it leaves the facility and alert our Australian operations team early enough to act on any shipment risk.

**What you’ll bring**

At least 3 or more years hands-on experience managing production at third-party food manufacturers or co-packers is
**essential**
. You should also have practical experience auditing food factories, checking compliance with SOPs, handling confidential technical information, planning packaging and coordinating dispatch. A qualification in food technology, food science, food processing or a related discipline is a
**must**
.

**What you’ll get**

* Attractive Salary
* Company laptop and phone
* Reimbursement of interstate and overseas expenses.

**To apply**
, send me your CV by LinkedIn message with your current location, earliest firm joining date and
**confirmation that you’re available for domestic and overseas travel as described**
.

Industry Technology Specialist - Technical Service: Distilling and Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guiding purpose. It is how we have made an impact, and it is how we will continue to make a difference.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As an Industry Technology Specialist for Distilling & Biofuel, you will join our Technical Service team within Planetary Health Biosolutions.
  
  
Working closely with our Grain Processing team, you will provide technical support to customers in the grain-based ethanol and biofuel industries. You will design and execute plant trials, troubleshoot complex production challenges, and help customers optimize fermentation and ethanol production processes.
  
  
Through your technical expertise, analytical approach, and cross-functional collaboration, you will turn scientific and process insights into practical solutions that support customer success and business development.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide high-quality technical service to grain-based distilleries and ethanol-producing plants across India.
* Design, coordinate, and execute plant trials and experiments related to grain processing, fermentation, and ethanol production.
* Analyze trial and production data, draw clear conclusions, and communicate findings to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Support customers in optimizing grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Recommend suitable yeast strains and support yeast propagation, viability, vitality, and performance management.
* Troubleshoot stuck or sluggish fermentations, contamination, low yeast viability, process deviations, and reduced ethanol yields.
* Optimize process parameters such as temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Conduct root cause analyses using production data, trends, and relevant statistical methods.
* Support the improvement of sterilization and Clean-in-Place processes to help customers prevent and control contamination.
* Build strong working relationships with customers and collaborate with commercial, application, laboratory, and other cross-functional teams.
* Share technical knowledge and train customer teams to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* Between 5 and 10 years of relevant professional experience in a grain-based distillery, ethanol plant, or biofuel production environment.
* Practical knowledge of grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience working with grains such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat.
* Technical knowledge of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Experience selecting and managing yeast strains for ethanol production.
* Knowledge of yeast propagation and the management of yeast viability and vitality.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation issues, including contamination, low yeast viability, sluggish or stuck fermentation, and reduced ethanol yield.
* The ability to analyze production and trial data using Microsoft Excel or another relevant data-analysis tool.
* The ability to plan and lead plant trials and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across India to support ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* A master’s degree in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* A strong understanding of yeast metabolism and its role in converting sugars into ethanol.
* Experience using statistical tools and data trends to investigate production deviations.
* Experience improving sterilization and Clean-in-Place protocols in an industrial production environment.
* A collaborative approach to solving technical challenges and sharing knowledge with customers and colleagues.
* The ability to work proactively, take responsibility, and translate new ideas into practical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative and scientifically driven environment where innovation, curiosity, and technical expertise are valued.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers, technical specialists, laboratory colleagues, and commercial teams while contributing to the advancement of biological solutions for the distilling and biofuel industries.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to apply your expertise to complex industrial challenges, develop new knowledge, and contribute to solutions that improve process performance and the use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.title: Poultry Nutrition Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Poultry Nutrition Specialist should have technical expertise and science-driven insights to design, evaluate, and optimize poultry feed formulations. In this role, you will support raw material selection, feed program design, and diet modifications to improve bird performance, health, feed efficiency, and cost-effectiveness. You will also provide analytical and advisory services to R&D, production, and commercial teams on key poultry nutritional considerations. You should be able to learn and adopt Cargill’s nutrition system and apply it in your feed formulations for precise nutrition.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Provide technical support and feed formulations to poultry producers and feed mills for precise nutrition, feeding programs (broilers, layers, breeders), and performance optimization.
* Formulate and optimize poultry feed formulation based on raw material quality, nutrient specifications, cost targets, and production goals.
* Monitor and evaluate feed quality, ingredient variability, and nutritional consistency to ensure feed meet required nutrient specifications and bird performance standards.
* Analyse performance data (FCR, body weight gain, egg production, mortality, etc.) and recommend nutritional interventions to address production challenges.
* Maintain and update nutritional databases (ingredients, feed formulations, nutrient matrices) using laboratory data and industry benchmarks.
* Collaborate with Cargill’s Global Nutrition experts and commercial teams to incorporate market trends, ingredient availability, and cost optimization strategies.
* Conduct trials at Cargill’s Technology Application Centre and support field trials to validate feed formulations, additives, and nutritional strategies and create scientific trial reports.
* Independently solve moderately complex nutritional and production issues, escalating more complex concerns to global experts when required.
* Deliver technical presentations, training sessions, and documentation to internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* M.V.Sc (Animal Nutrition).
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in poultry nutrition, feed formulation and poultry industry.
* Demonstrated knowledge of poultry nutritional requirements (broilers, layers, breeders) and feed ingredient evaluation.
* Experience with feed formulation software and nutritional modelling.
* Other minimum qualifications may apply.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ph.D. in Animal Nutrition.
* Experience in commercial poultry operations or feed industry.
* Knowledge of alternative ingredients, feed additives, and enzyme technologies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.

jobs.title: Wedding Production Manager - Decor & On-Ground Execution
jobs.description:
Wedding Production Manager - Decor & On-Ground Execution

Panigrahana Weddings | Bengaluru | Full-time, on-site | 3 openings

  

Own the practical work that turns an approved wedding design into a finished setup. We are hiring wedding production professionals who can prepare accurate BOQs, organise warehouse inventory and suppliers, coordinate labour teams and lead decor execution on site.

  

COMPENSATION

INR 6-8 lakh per annum fixed + INR 2 lakh per annum performance-linked variable. Total annual earning opportunity: INR 8-10 lakh, including variable pay. The variable component is performance-linked and is not guaranteed fixed pay.

  

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

* Translate approved designs and event plans into detailed bills of quantities (BOQs), covering items, dimensions, quantities, materials, finishes and sourcing requirements.
* Check warehouse availability and condition; prepare picking lists and coordinate repairs, fabrication, packing, labelling, loading and dispatch.
* Identify rental and procurement needs, obtain vendor quotations, compare scope and coordinate bookings within approved budgets and authority.
* Arrange the labour and specialist crews needed for installation, styling support, dismantling and loading. Brief supervisors clearly on responsibilities, sequencing and deadlines.
* Coordinate florists, fabricators, carpenters, lighting and other production vendors so their work fits the approved design and installation schedule.
* Conduct site visits, take measurements and confirm access, loading arrangements, installation windows, venue restrictions, power needs and practical execution requirements.
* Build and run the production schedule, track readiness and follow up on missing items before dispatch.
* Lead on-ground decor execution, check quantities and finish quality, resolve site issues promptly and keep the planning and design teams informed.
* Track approved changes and additional requirements, maintain cost records and obtain approval before committing to extra expenditure.
* Coordinate safe installation practices with qualified specialists and venue teams. Keep access routes clear and ensure crews follow site requirements.
* Oversee dismantling, inventory reconciliation, damage reporting, vendor closure and organised returns to the warehouse.

  

WHAT WE NEED

* Previous hands-on production or operations experience in weddings, wedding decor or live events, with direct responsibility for decor setup and execution.
* Ability to prepare and work from BOQs, item lists, production schedules and cost trackers using spreadsheets.
* Practical understanding of flats, backdrops, stages, structures, fabrics, furniture, props, floral requirements and finishes, including how items are transported and installed.
* Experience coordinating warehouse teams, labour supervisors, vendors and transport under event deadlines.
* Strong organisation, clear communication, ownership and calm problem-solving on site.
* Availability to work from Bengaluru, visit venues and attend installations, event execution and dismantling, including event-related travel and timings as required.

  

This role is for someone who can organise the materials, people and logistics and take responsibility for delivering the decor on ground. We welcome wedding production managers, event operations managers and experienced decor execution professionals with relevant hands-on work.

  

HOW TO APPLY

Apply with your CV. Briefly describe one wedding or decor project you personally executed, your responsibilities for the BOQ and warehouse dispatch, and how you coordinated labour and vendors. Include a redacted sample BOQ or project photographs if you have permission to share them; do not disclose private client or vendor information. Tell us your current location and notice period.

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
**Role Overview**

The Head Chef is responsible for overseeing all kitchen operations, including menu planning, food preparation, quality control, and team management. This role ensures the highest culinary standards, cost efficiency, and guest satisfaction while maintaining hygiene and safety standards. The Head Chef will lead the kitchen team to create memorable dining experiences that align with the resorts brand and vision.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Culinary Operations**

* Supervise and manage all kitchen operations including restaurants, banquets, and room dining.
* Design, plan, and update menus according to guest preferences, seasonal availability, and cost considerations.
* Maintain food quality, presentation, and taste standards across all outlets.
* Oversee food preparation and ensure timely service during peak hours.
* Conduct food tastings and maintain consistency in recipes and portion control.

  

**Team Management & Training**

* Lead, train, and motivate chefs, cooks, and kitchen assistants to deliver excellence.
* Schedule kitchen staff and allocate duties to ensure efficient workflow.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, creativity, and discipline within the kitchen.
* Conduct performance reviews and recommend training and development programs.

  

**Inventory & Cost Control**

* Manage inventory of raw materials, kitchen supplies, and equipment.
* Control food costs, minimize wastage, and ensure optimum utilization of resources.
* Collaborate with the purchase department for sourcing quality ingredients at competitive prices.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, consumption, and wastage.

  

**Quality, Hygiene & Safety**

* Ensure compliance with FSSAI standards, hygiene regulations, and food safety protocols.
* Conduct regular kitchen inspections to ensure cleanliness and equipment maintenance.
* Implement SOPs for kitchen safety, storage, and sanitation.
* Maintain proper documentation for audits and inspections.

  

**Menu Innovation & Guest Engagement**

* Develop new dishes, themed menus, and special promotions to enhance guest experience.
* Incorporate local and seasonal ingredients to add uniqueness to the menu.
* Interact with guests during service or special events to receive feedback and improve offerings.

  

**Coordination & Reporting**

* Coordinate with F&B, Banquets, and Front Office teams for event planning and menu execution.
* Prepare reports on kitchen performance, sales, and cost control for management review.
* Participate in management meetings and contribute to strategic planning for F&B growth.

  

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Degree / Diploma in Culinary Arts or Hotel Management.
* **6 years of culinary experience**, with at least **6-7 years in a leadership role** as Sous Chef or Head Chef.
* Expertise in multi-cuisine operations (Indian, Continental, Oriental, etc.).
* Strong leadership, creativity, and organizational skills.
* Excellent knowledge of food costing, budgeting, and inventory management.
* Hands-on experience with kitchen operations, food presentation, and modern culinary trends.
* Ability to thrive under pressure and maintain quality during peak operations.

We're one of the world's largest food and beverage companies and a trusted producer of high-quality, great-tasting, and nutritious foods, earning us a spot on 97% of American household tables. **Analytics - Business Analyst**

**Role Summary:**

This role is responsible for turning business questions into structured analyses, meaningful metrics, measurable KPIs, actionable insights, and decision- ready recommendations. The role combines traditional analytics, statistical methods, and business translation to improve planning, performance, and process decisions across the function. It contributes to team and business goals by identifying opportunities, testing hypotheses, and enabling stakeholders to act on reliable, well-explained data. The role also helps determine how a problem should be solved using data, whether through reporting, BI, traditional analytics, or advanced data science methods.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end analytical problem solving by translating business questions into hypotheses, analysis plans, and decision-ready recommendations.

* Own KPI design, metric definitions, dashboards, reports, and recurring insight packs that improve visibility into business performance.
* Analyze large structured and semi-structured datasets using SQL, Python, Excel, and BI tools to identify trends, risks, anomalies, root causes, and opportunities.
* Apply statistical methods such as hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, segmentation, cohort analysis, and experimentation design to evaluate initiatives and quantify impact.
* Design and assess A/B tests, interpret statistical and practical significance, and communicate business implications clearly.
* Support basic predictive analysis and time-series forecasting where relevant, including simple model development, validation, and scenario analysis.
* Collaborate with business, product, operations, engineering, and data teams to improve data quality, instrumentation, analytical workflows, and action tracking.
* Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reproducible, and well documented through validation checks, notebook discipline, version control, and clear metric logic.

**Required Qualifications:**

**Experience:**

* Experience in data analysis, business analysis, business intelligence/reporting, or techno-functional analytics roles.
* Hands-on experience with SQL, Python, advanced Excel, and one BI platform such as Power BI or Tableau.
* Experience working with Jupyter notebooks, GCP, and BigQuery.
* Proven experience in exploratory data analysis, reporting, dashboarding, data validation, and several of the following: statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, A/B testing, segmentation, cohort analysis, predictive modelling, time-series forecasting, or experimentation design.
* Experience partnering with stakeholders to frame business questions, define KPIs and success metrics, and translate findings into practical actions.
* Experience working cross-functionally and translating business needs into analytical or technical deliverables.

**Skills:**

* Strong technical skills in SQL, Python, Excel, data wrangling, dashboarding, statistical methods, data visualization, and basic ML workflows.
* Working knowledge of statistical and analytical libraries such as scikit-learn and statsmodels for basic modelling and analysis.
* Functional expertise in problem structuring, metric design, root-cause analysis, forecasting, experimentation, and causal reasoning.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain methods, assumptions, and recommendations clearly to non- technical audiences.
* Analytical mindset, high attention to detail, data-quality discipline, and comfort working independently in ambiguous environments.

**AI Skills (Mandatory):**

* Proficiency in leveraging AI tools for daily engineering tasks to enhance productivity, optimize effort, and ensure cost-aware AI assistance.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with Git-based workflows, reusable notebook practices, and collaboration with data science or ML teams.
* Exposure to advanced analytics techniques such as forecasting, causal inference, or uplift measurement.
* Domain experience in retail, grocery, e-commerce, operations, pricing, supply chain, marketing, or customer analytics.
