jobs.title: Food Quality Analyst — Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO)
jobs.description:
**About the School of Environment and Sustainability (SES)**

The IIHS Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO) at the Kengeri campus is an important part of the SES and integrates state of the art observation and measurement systems for biodiversity, air, water and soil, food and ecosystem services to serve the needs of sustainable management of the campus and function as a research and educational resource for the larger community.

The Food Safety Testing Lab is a part of the LTUEO and Sustainable Urban Agriculture initiative at the IIHS Kengeri campus, within the SES.

**Job Description**

IIHS seeks a meticulous and technically skilled food quality analyst/ technician to support the Food Safety Testing Lab in understanding and communicating the changing chemical and microbiological variables of food (both cooked and uncooked) on campus and in the neighboring lake, forest, and urban ecosystems.

The role will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative tests to determine the physical and chemical properties of food, recording and compiling the test results, preparing charts and reports, as well as preparing and incubating plates with cultures. It will also involve defining quality assurance targets and procedures and ensuring their maintenance and continued improvement by reviewing targets, protocols, supplies, processes, equipment, and technologies for quality standards.

The candidate will be expected to spend substantial time at the IIHS Kengeri Campus and provide support as needed, on other IIHS projects under the SES.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual

consent and based on performance, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Collecting, processing and analysing food, vegetable, drink and dairy samples at regular intervals as a part of the campus environmental monitoring system;
* Assisting in setting up and maintaining a food quality lab, maintaining and calibrating equipment, and preparing SOPs and related documents;
* Preparing and maintaining hard-copy and computer-based data sets on all chemical and microbiological food quality environmental variables;
* Helping prepare regular updates on the food safety lab’s activities for the IIHS newsletter and other IIHS communication outputs;
* Contributing to knowledge-sharing events, publications and presentations featuring the food safety lab’s activities, observations and findings at appropriate internal and external forums as needed;
* Participating in relevant teaching and training activities; contributing to curriculum design and the development of teaching materials, including case studies, as relevant;
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The food quality analyst will be an External Consultant coordinating with the Lead – Research, SES at IIHS, be part of the larger SES team and will be required to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development team a diverse group of internal teams and external individuals/ organisations, and students.

**Person Specification**

The candidate should have:

* A Master’s degree of Science/ Technology in Food Technology, Food Science and technology, Food Science and Nutrition, Food Safety and Quality Assurance, Food Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry/ Food Microbiology, Microbiology, or Chemistry;
* 3-4 years of experience in chemical, physical, microbiological, and sensory assessment of food, vegetables and drinks.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual consent, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time. This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in the Kengeri Campus, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

*Designed in India, designed for the world.*

**The role**

You'll join the revenue team, reporting to the Head of Sales, and own the technical side of every deal: discovery, demo, proof-of-concept and handover to implementation. You'll work with Indian enterprises serving the domestic market and with exporters selling into the US, EU and beyond.

**What you'll do**

* Run technical discovery with plant heads, quality and supply-chain leaders, and IT, and map the customer's current flows of material, data and systems
* Deliver demos tailored to the customer's own products, lines and warehouses
* Design and run PoCs with product and engineering: scope them, set success criteria, deploy and present the results
* Specify and configure sensors and scanners (barcode/QR, RFID, environmental sensors) for PoCs and deployments, and work with hardware partners on the shop floor
* Answer integration, data and security questions (ERP/WMS, APIs, device connectivity) and compliance questions (FSMA 204, EUDR, GS1, HACCP)
* Write solution proposals and RFP/RFI responses, using AI tools to move fast without cutting corners
* Bring field insight back to product so it shapes what we build next

**Your first 90 days**

* **30 days:**
  Know the platform and our standard hardware set well enough to demo it end to end, and shadow live customer engagements
* **60 days:**
  Run discovery and demos on your own
* **90 days:**
  Lead a PoC, including on-site device setup, from scoping to customer sign-off

**Must-haves**

* 2–5 years (career breaks included) in B2B SaaS pre-sales, solutions engineering or technical consulting
* A solid grasp of SaaS architecture, APIs and data integration
* Comfort explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical buyers, and clear writing for proposals and RFPs

**Nice-to-haves**

* Supply chain, manufacturing, FMCG, seafood, meat or agri-export exposure
* GS1 standards, serialization, packaging aggregation or EPCIS
* SAP or other ERP/WMS integration experience
* Hands-on experience with scanners, sensors or other connected devices in a production or field setting
* Hindi, Kannada or another regional language for plant-floor conversations

**How we work**

We work hybrid. Most work is remote, and we meet in person 4–8 days a month (usually 1–2 days a week) at our Bengaluru HQ in Whitefield, or at customer sites. You'll need to live within commuting distance of Whitefield. Site visits are part of the role: typically once a month to customer plants, warehouses and processing centres, mostly day trips around Bengaluru during working hours. Some sites are meat and seafood processing facilities. Occasional outstation trips are planned in advance, travel and stay are arranged and paid by us, and your first visits are with a teammate.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay plus variable pay tied to revenue
* Real ownership in a small, award-winning team working on food safety at national and global scale

**Hiring process**

A 30-minute intro call → a technical conversation → a mock discovery and demo with our team → a conversation with our founders.

**How to apply**

Click the Apply link to go to our short application form. It takes about 10 minutes: your CV, a few practical details, and two brief questions in your own words. We'd rather explore your experience properly in conversation than ask you to write essays, and we appreciate your interest.

jobs.title: Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) Technical Service: Distilling & Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we work in close partnership with our customers to create a better world every day. We use science and biosolutions to help industries improve performance and make better use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
Join our Grain Processing team within Planetary Health Biosolutions in Bangalore, India, where you will work alongside industry technology specialists and laboratory colleagues to support customers in the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Industry Technology Specialist (ITS) – Distilling & Biofuel, you will provide technical service and expertise to customers in the grain processing, distilling, and biofuel industries.
  
  
You will lead plant trials and technical experiments, troubleshoot complex production challenges, analyze process data, and translate technical findings into practical recommendations. Through close collaboration with customers and cross-functional teams, you will help advance technical solutions and contribute to meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide technical service and process expertise to grain-based ethanol and biofuel customers.
* Develop and lead experimental plans and plant trials and communicate findings and conclusions to support business development.
* Troubleshoot fermentation challenges, including stuck or sluggish fermentation, contamination, reduced ethanol yield, and yeast performance issues.
* Support optimization of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Optimize process parameters including temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Support yeast strain selection, propagation, viability, vitality, and fermentation performance.
* Conduct root cause analyses using process data, trends, and statistical tools to address production deviations.
* Identify and help mitigate contamination through effective sterilization and CIP practices.
* Collaborate with customers and internal teams and share technical knowledge to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A Bachelor’s degree (BE/B.Tech), Master’s degree, or Ph.D. in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of professional experience in a grain-based distillery or biofuel production environment.
* Practical expertise in grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience with grain milling involving materials such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat, as well as liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Practical knowledge of yeast selection, propagation, viability, vitality, metabolism, and fermentation performance.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation, yeast performance, contamination, and ethanol-yield challenges.
* Ability to develop and execute experimental plans and plant trials.
* Willingness and ability to travel frequently across India to provide technical services to ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including root cause analysis.
* Experience analyzing process and statistical data and managing technical data using Microsoft Excel or other relevant tools.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical findings and conclusions to customers and cross-functional stakeholders.
* A collaborative approach to technical problem-solving and knowledge sharing.
* A proactive approach to your work, with an interest in developing and implementing innovative technical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative technical environment where scientific expertise, innovation, and practical problem-solving come together. You will have opportunities to work closely with customers, cross-functional colleagues, and specialists while contributing to the development and application of biosolutions for the Distilling and Biofuel industry.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.description:
***Role:-*** Factory Manager / Plant Manager

(Food Manufacturing)

***Employment Type:-*** Full time, Permanent

***Location:-*** Jigani, Bangalore

***Experience:-***  8 to 12 years in food/FMCG manufacturing, incl. 5+ years leading a plant.

***Direct reports:-*** Production Officer, QC, Stores & Warehouse In-charge, Dispatch team

  

***About US:-***

  

We are a long-established brand with a proven track record of strong, long-standing customer base. We are looking to expand our product portfolio. While deeply rooted in our legacy, our focus remains on innovation and growth.

  

***The Role:-***

  

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Factory Manager to run day-to-day operations at our food plant in Jigani. You will know the shop floor, understand food safety deeply, and build a strong culture of hygiene, safety and continuous improvement.

  

***Responsibilities:-***

  

* **Production:** Plan and run production to meet volume, quality and delivery targets. Track KPIs (OEE, yield, wastage, downtime, cost per unit, OTIF) and act fast on gaps. Make the best use of materials, utilities and manpower, and support new product trials with R&D.
* **Food safety and quality:** Own the plants food safety system and FSSAI compliance, including batch traceability, mock recalls, root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* **Safety and compliance:** Ensure compliance with the Factories Act, Legal Metrology, Pollution Control Board, fire safety and other laws. Build a zero-harm safety culture, manage effluent and waste, and be the plants contact for inspectors.
* **Maintenance:** Keep equipment and utilities (DG sets, water treatment) reliable through planned maintenance. Plan and manage capex projects on time and budget.
* **People:** Lead and develop supervisors, operators and contract workers. Plan shifts and training, handle grievances fairly, and drive discipline and accountability.
* **Cost, inventory and dispatch:** Manage the plant budget and cost targets. Control stock with FIFO/FEFO to minimise expiry. Plan daily dispatches, manage transporters, and handle paperwork (invoices, e-way bills) and returns.
* **Reporting and improvement:** Share regular MIS reports with management. Lead Lean, 5S, Kaizen and Six Sigma initiatives, and bring in automation and ERP/digital tools.

  

***Required Qualification:-***

  

* Bachelors degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Dairy Technology, Chemical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.
* 8 to 12 years in food, beverage or FMCG manufacturing, with 5+ years as Plant/Factory Manager or equivalent, including hands-on shop-floor experience.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI, HACCP, GMP and ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000, plus working knowledge of the Factories Act, labour and environmental laws.
* Experience managing a large multi-shift workforce, including contract labour.

  

***Preferred:-***

  

* MBA/Masters in Operations; FSSC 22000 / ISO 22000 / BRCGS Lead Auditor or FoSTaC certification; Lean Six Sigma belt.
* Experience with SAP or another ERP, and knowledge of the local regional language.

  

***Key skills:-***

  

* Leadership that motivates teams and leads by example on the shop floor.
* A food safety mindset, treating hygiene and safety as non-negotiable.
* Data-driven problem solving (5 Why, Fishbone, FMEA) and calm decision-making in breakdowns or recalls.
* Good planning, budgeting and communication with management, regulators, auditors and staff.
* Knowledge of Kannada and Hindi.

  

***How success is measured:-***

  

* Production vs plan and on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery.
* OEE, yield, wastage and cost per unit vs budget.
* Customer complaints, zero recalls and zero lost-time injuries.
* Inventory accuracy, low expiry write-offs, and team attrition and training.

  

***Working conditions:-***

  

* Based at the plant, with shop-floor presence across shifts as needed.
* Must follow hygiene and GMP rules (protective clothing, health checks) and be available for emergencies.

* Identify new opportunities in fermentation, biocatalysis, enzymatic synthesis, microbial conversion and sustainable chemical manufacturing.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their technical and commercial feasibility.
* Build internal biotechnology capabilities and technology platforms.
* Establish appropriate project stage-gate and technical review systems.

  

Product and Process Development

* Lead biotechnology process development from laboratory proof-of-concept through pilot and commercial scale.
* Develop and optimize fermentation and biotransformation processes.
* Optimize media, feed strategy, inoculum, fermentation parameters, reaction conditions and downstream recovery.

* Improve yield, productivity, conversion, purity, cycle time and process consistency.

Scale-Up and Commercialization

* Conduct periodic technical and management reviews.
* Identify technical risks and establish mitigation plans.

* Prepare technical reports and management presentations.

* Maintain appropriate documentation and traceability of development activities.

* Ensure safe handling of microorganisms, enzymes, chemicals and biological materials.

* Mentor scientists in experimental design, troubleshooting and scientific decision-making.
* Develop succession plans for critical technical positions.
* Promote collaboration between R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Commercial functions.

  

I. External Collaboration

**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Compliance Manager to strengthen our regulatory compliance framework and support business operations across digital lending, payment services and other financial products.
  
  
The role involves interpreting regulatory requirements, advising business and support teams, managing regulatory changes and ensuring effective implementation of compliance practices across products, partnerships and operations.

* Regulatory Change Management
* Monitor applicable RBI directions, NPCI guidelines, FIU-IND requirements and other relevant regulatory developments.
* Assess the impact of regulatory changes and coordinate with business and support functions to define implementation plans.
* Track compliance actions, responsibilities and timelines to ensure timely implementation.
* Product and Partner Advisory
* Review new products, lender partnerships, customer journeys across Olyv applications and partner platforms, including co-lending arrangements.
* Evaluate customer disclosures, marketing communications and significant process changes from a regulatory compliance perspective.
* Document compliance requirements and escalate unresolved regulatory risks before product or process launches.
* Policies and Procedures
* Draft, review and update compliance policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and operational checklists.
* Ensure alignment with applicable requirements relating to digital lending, BBPS, UPI, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act), outsourcing, collections and grievance redressal.

* Compliance Oversight and Training
* Prepare compliance updates and reports for the Board and senior management.
* Develop and conduct compliance awareness and training programmes for sales and support teams.
* Coordinate with Product, Risk, IT, Finance and Operations teams to monitor and close corrective action plans.
* Agreements and Business Arrangements
* Review business arrangements, partnership agreements and contractual documentation for regulatory compliance.
* Identify compliance gaps and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure necessary modifications and ongoing adherence to regulatory requirements.

**Candidate Profile**
**Educational Qualification**

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS).
* LL.B. qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in an NBFC, fintech or financial services organisation.

**Technical Skills And Expertise**

* Working knowledge of RBI, FIU-IND, SEBI and NPCI regulations and guidelines applicable to NBFCs, BBPS and UPI.
* Familiarity with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
* Strong understanding of regulatory interpretation, compliance documentation and policy drafting.
* Ability to assess regulatory risks and translate requirements into actionable compliance measures.

**Preferred Experience**

* Exposure to consumer lending and digital lending journeys.
* Experience handling Lending Service Provider (LSP) arrangements and lender partnerships.
* Familiarity with supervisory reviews, regulatory inspections and lender-partner compliance assessments.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong analytical and regulatory interpretation skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong documentation and drafting capabilities.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive compliance initiatives independently.
* A proactive approach towards identifying regulatory risks and ensuring timely resolution.

jobs.description:
**About Olyv**
Olyv (formerly SmartCoin) is an automated FinTech platform focused on making credit accessible and promoting financial wellness for millions of Indians. Through technology, data analytics and AI-driven solutions, Olyv provides digital financial services, including credit, digital gold savings and financial wellness solutions.
  
  
At Olyv, we are committed to building a stronger financial ecosystem by making financial services more accessible, transparent and convenient.

We are looking for a Compliance Testing – Manager to independently assess and test the effectiveness of Olyv's compliance controls. jobs.title: Manager - Quality Control with Inorganic Chemical Producers
jobs.description:
**Job Profile:**

**Laboratory Setup and Commissioning**

* Establish and operationalize the QC laboratory for the new plant.
* Identify, plan, and install required laboratory equipment, instruments, glassware, chemicals, and utilities.
* Support qualification, calibration, and validation of laboratory instruments and testing systems.
* Develop laboratory layout, workflow, sample handling systems, and storage arrangements for safe and efficient operation.
* Ensure the laboratory is designed and run in accordance with safety norms relevant to hazardous chemical handling.

**Laboratory Management**

* Manage day-to-day laboratory operations to ensure timely and accurate testing.
* Maintain laboratory equipment in working condition through calibration, preventive maintenance, and vendor coordination.
* Monitor inventory of chemicals, reagents, glassware, standards, consumables, and spare parts to prevent disruption.
* Ensure proper housekeeping, storage, labelling, and disposal practices in the laboratory.
* Control laboratory records, test reports, logbooks, and retention samples systematically.

**Testing and Quality Decision-Making**

* Conduct, review, and approve testing of Raw Materials (RM), Work-in-Progress (WiP), Finished Goods (FG), Packing Materials.
* Release or reject materials based on specifications and test results.
* Ensure timely availability of test results to production, stores, and dispatch functions.
* Monitor conformance to product specifications, internal standards, and customer requirements.
* Investigate out-of-specification (OOS), abnormal trends, and deviations, and recommend corrective actions.

**Method Development, Standardization, and Documentation**

* Prepare and maintain specifications, test methods, standard operating procedures, formats, and work instructions for all QC activities.
* Standardise test methods for raw materials, intermediates, finished products, and packing materials.
* Ensure proper documentation of sampling, testing, approvals, rejections, deviations, and retest requirements.
* Maintain certificate of analysis formats and related quality records.
* Support creation and upkeep of documentation required for certifications, audits, and customer requirements.

**Quality Systems and Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with company quality standards, statutory requirements, and applicable good laboratory practices.
* Support implementation and maintenance of quality management systems.
* Participate in internal audits, customer audits, and third-party inspections.
* Ensure laboratory readiness for audits through proper records, traceability, and system discipline.
* Support non-conformance reporting, CAPA closure, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Coordination with Plant Functions**

* Work closely with production, stores, procurement, maintenance, and dispatch teams for smooth material flow and quality control.
* Coordinate sampling plans and test priorities in line with production schedules and dispatch timelines.
* Provide timely feedback to production on process deviations and product quality issues.
* Coordinate with procurement for quality issues related to incoming raw materials and vendor performance.

**Safety and Risk Control**

* Ensure strict adherence to safety practices in the laboratory, especially considering hazardous raw materials.
* Train staff on safe handling of chemicals, use of PPE, emergency response, spill control, and waste disposal.
* Ensure safe storage and handling of reagents, samples, and hazardous substances.
* Work closely with EHS and plant leadership to maintain a safe QC environment.

**Team Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build, guide, and supervise the QC team including chemists, analysts, and lab assistants.
* Allocate work, review performance, and ensure technical competence of team members.
* Train team members on test methods, equipment usage, documentation, and laboratory discipline.
* Foster a culture of accuracy, responsiveness, compliance, and ownership.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Improve laboratory efficiency, turnaround time, testing reliability, and reporting quality.
* Track quality trends and generate actionable insights for reduction in rejection, rework, and process variability.
* Recommend better testing practices, automation opportunities, and stronger analytical controls.
* Contribute to improvement of plant quality performance and customer confidence.

  
  

**Desired Profile:**

* M.Sc (Chemistry / Inorganic Chemistry) with 8 to 10 years experience in Quality Control preferably in the manufacturing of inorganic chemicals with Chemicals / Inorganic Chemicals / Speciality Chemicals / Process Manufacturing.
* Experience in setting up or stabilising QC systems / laboratories in a new or expanding plant will be strongly preferred.
* Exposure to handling hazardous chemicals and related testing/safety disciplines is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of laboratory systems, chemical testing, and quality control processes.
* Hands-on experience with laboratory equipment, calibration, and consumable planning.
* Good understanding of specifications, sampling, test methods, COA preparation, and rejection/release protocols.
* Strong documentation and audit readiness mind-set.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with production and other plant departments.
* High level of discipline, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
* Leadership capability to build and manage a QC team in a growing organisation.
* Familiarity with ERP/LIMS/reporting systems will be an advantage.

jobs.title: DGM Regulatory Affairs (Agrochemicals - USA, EU, LATAM & ROW), Delhi
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

* Manage the division in a pragmatic and cost-effective way for successful global registrations & renewals of technical and formulation products in all international markets.
* Review the dossier submissions by team and suggest the improvements needed.
* Led and manage regulatory team and provide them proper guidance and make sure assigned task in completed within defined time frame
* Planning, evaluation, and monitoring of budget concerning the data generation or country registration related expenditures.
* Internal discussions within regulatory team to improve knowledge and implement suggested strategies.
* Actively monitor the developments on regulations across countries, analyze the impact on existing/ongoing product registrations or future projects.
* Collaborate with cross functional divisions and extend support in finding suitable products and for development of new products in various markets.
* Coordinate with CROs for data generation, budgeting and follow up for timely completion of Projects.
* Act as a Sponsor representative & study monitor for Toxicological studies (including mammalian toxicity, Geno toxicity and Eco toxicity) for submission to global regulators.
* Determine the technical equivalence of active substances and comparability of impurities.
* Risk assessment of Agrochemical active substances, intermediates, raw materials, impurities etc.,
* Act as a lead in coordinating with registration team members, R&D, Formulation Development, and QC to ensure completeness of data for dossier submissions within the timelines.
* Determine technical equivalence of active substances and comparability of impurities for submission in overseas countries.
* Prepare (Q)SAR prediction reports for submission to various global regulatory authorities.
* Make risk assessment of Agrochemical active substances, intermediates, raw materials, impurities etc., from time to time.
* Conduct research on new regulations and their potential impact on companies existing or future products.
* Represent and participate actively on behalf of companys in Associations or Working Groups that are recommended by Management from time to time.
* Interact with Marketing team and customers for identifying suitable products.
* Act as a focal point to address industrial toxicology/risk assessment issues, demonstrate and defend the safety of Company's products and processes on global platform.
* Involve in development and training of the registration team members.
* Review the registration requirements & gap analysis provided by the team and prepare the budget.
* Acts as a Study Monitor for Toxicological studies (including mammalian toxicity, Genotoxicity and Ecotoxicity) according to international guidelines like OECD / OCSPP / EC/ICH

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

* M.Sc. / M.Tech. / M.Pharm / Ph.D. in Chemistry, Agricultural Sciences, Toxicology, Environmental Sciences, Life Sciences, or a related discipline.
* 15 to 20 years of relevant experience exclusively in the Agrochemical / Crop Protection industry, with substantial exposure to global regulatory affairs.
* Proven expertise in registration of crop protection chemicals / agrochemical products across international markets and management of end-to-end regulatory submissions.
* Strong preference for candidates with an educational background directly relevant to Agrochemicals / Crop Protection and International Regulatory Affairs.
* Hands-on experience with regulatory requirements, submission strategies, dossiers and registration processes across multiple international markets.
* Ability to develop and execute product registration and regulatory strategies aligned with business objectives and target-market requirements.
* Ability to review scientific, technical and regulatory data and assess data adequacy, compliance and suitability for regulatory submission.
* Strong capability to address regulatory authority queries, deficiencies and data requirements and coordinate appropriate responses with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proven experience in managing multiple regulatory projects, timelines, priorities, cross-functional teams and external consultants
* Strong technical knowledge in at least one core area such as Chemistry, Toxicology, Agriculture, Environmental Science or related regulatory sciences.
* Experience in regulatory project budgeting, cost planning and monitoring for international registration programs.
* Ability to work closely with R&D, Chemistry, Toxicology, Biology, Product Development, Legal, Commercial and Business teams to drive registrations successfully.
* Must have a demonstrated and successful track record of registering agrochemical / crop protection products in international markets.
* Strong leadership, decision-making, stakeholder-management and communication skills suitable for a DGM-level Regulatory Affairs leadership position.

jobs.title: Growth Product Manager B2B Cloud Marketplace & Data Platform Germn MNC
jobs.description:
**Job description**

  
  

**Purpose of the role**

  

Company Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Org.

MPS\_OS is the cloud and data platform of Company MPS. Its products, including cloud cost and AI spend management, observability and data streaming, are offered to engineering and finance teams that buy through the cloud marketplaces they already use. The aim is a self-serve motion: a customer finds the product on a marketplace, tries it free up to a threshold, pays through their existing cloud commitment, and expands as usage grows.

The Product-led Growth Manager builds and runs this motion. The role owns the path from listing and sign-up to activation, conversion and expansion, so that growth comes from the product itself and from a funnel that works without adding sales headcount at the same pace.

**Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Self-serve funnel ownership** - Own the end-to-end funnel: discovery, sign-up, install, activation, conversion and expansion. Define the activation event and the metrics for every step, and report them regularly.

**Marketplace listings and billing** - Own listings and commercial setup on the major cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud): public and private offers, metering, billing and drawdown against customer commitments. Work with Finance on invoicing and revenue recognition.

**Pricing and packaging** - Design free tiers, usage thresholds and paid plans. Keep the free product clearly separate from the enterprise offering so that free usage builds demand and does not erode paid value.

**Onboarding and time to value** - Design the first-run experience, documentation, sample data and guided set-up that take a new user to a first valuable result quickly, together with engineering and design.

**Lifecycle and expansion** - Build upgrade triggers, in-product prompts, lifecycle communication and account-expansion plays. Identify where usage signals a team is ready for more modules or for an enterprise conversation.

**Analytics and experimentation** - Instrument the product, build funnel and cohort dashboards, and run structured experiments on pages, onboarding, pricing and messaging. Make decisions from evidence and share what was learned.

**Go-to-market alignment** - Work with global marketing and sales on demand generation, partner channels and incentives that reward self-serve conversion. Agree clearly when an account moves from self-serve to a sales-assisted motion.

**Product feedback loop** - Bring usage data and user feedback into the roadmap. Prioritize the product changes that move activation, conversion and retention.

**Community and developer experience** - Own the quality of documentation, tutorials and the community presence that technical buyers use to evaluate a product.

**Entry strategy and expansion across products** - Choose the entry products and customer segments, for example AI spend and cloud cost management, and sequence the next Platform products into the same self-serve model.

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Number of self-serve sign-ups and activation rate
* Time to first value
* Free-to-paid conversion
* Share of revenue that is self-serve and billed through cloud marketplaces
* Expansion and net revenue retention of self-serve accounts
* Software attach on cloud accounts served by MPS
* Cost to acquire and payback on the self-serve funnel
* Speed and quality of experiments run

**Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, business or a related field; a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, growth or product marketing, with at least 4 years owning a self-serve or product-led growth motion in B2B software, developer tools or cloud infrastructure.
* Has launched a product on a cloud marketplace (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud) or run a free-to-paid funnel with measurable results.
* Experience in a thin, early funnel, with little data and a product that is being separated from an enterprise offering, is a strong advantage.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Product-led growth fundamentals: activation, time to value, conversion, expansion, free tiers and usage-based pricing.
* Cloud marketplace mechanics: listings, private offers, metering, commit drawdown and co-sell programmes.
* Familiarity with cloud cost management (FinOps), observability or data platforms, and with the technical buyer who evaluates them.
* Product analytics and experimentation: funnel and cohort analysis, A/B testing, SQL or equivalent, and tools such as Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar.
* Lifecycle marketing and in-product messaging, and the basics of SEO and developer content.

**Commercial skills**

* Pricing and packaging, unit economics and payback thinking.
* Ability to align sales, marketing and partners around a motion that changes how people are rewarded.

**Personal attributes**

* Curious, analytical and hands-on; comfortable building the first version of a funnel and improving it weekly.
* Strong written communication, and clarity in explaining a metric or a decision to senior stakeholders.
* Collaborative influencer who works across engineering, design, marketing, finance and sales without formal authority.
* Ownership of outcomes, and comfort with setting up the metrics that hold the role itself to account.

**Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for Platform engineering and security teams
* Global marketing and global go-to-market leadership
* Finance (pricing, billing, revenue recognition) and Legal
* Cloud marketplace and alliance managers at the hyperscalers
* Channel and technology partners
* Product owners of other MPS stacks that share the platform

**How to read this role**

This is a growth and product role with business accountability. It is not a sales role and not a pure marketing role. The ideal candidate has built a self-serve motion from a weak starting point and knows how cloud marketplaces turn usage into revenue.

jobs.description:
**Job description**

  
  

**Purpose of the role**

  

Company Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Company.

. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll system play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

**Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll platform using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

**Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
* Number-plate recognition, computer vision and sensor fusion; understanding of accuracy metrics, confidence cascades and model monitoring.
* Edge computing, plaza and back-office systems, and integration through APIs; familiarity with traffic management and enforcement systems is an advantage.
* Certification, equipment standards, cybersecurity and data protection as they apply to roadside systems.
* Able to read an architecture, challenge a design and translate field problems into engineering requirements.

**Commercial skills**

* Unit economics, pricing and service-level commercials; comfortable with a P&L view of a product.
* Negotiation and relationship skills with authorities, banks and vendors.

**Personal attributes**

* Strong ownership and bias to action; comfortable operating with ambiguity in a new business.
* Field-minded: willing to spend time at sites and with operations teams, with regular domestic travel.
* Clear structured communicator, in writing and in the room, who can explain a technical trade-off to a senior stakeholder.
* Integrity and discretion when working with public authorities and sensitive data.
* Collaborative leader who influences without formal authority across engineering, business and partners.

**Additional Information**

**Who the role works with**

* Product Area Leader for the UtilizationStack (MPS/PAZ)
* Engineering, AI and DevSecOps teams
* Delivery, site and operations teams
* Bid and tender team, and the Global Partner Manager
* Finance, Legal and Compliance
* Regional business leadership (MPS/RBR)
* Highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and vendors
* Product owners for Mobility Prism and for financial services built on toll data

**How to read this role**

This is a product-ownership role with business accountability, not a project management or pure engineering role. The ideal candidate combines systems depth, field experience, commercial judgement and the ability to win trust with authorities and partners.

jobs.description:
**MANAGER/SENIOR MANAGER – ENGINEERING**

**Department:** Engineering

**Reports to:** Director - Admin Operations

**Location:** Bangalore

**About the Company:** Perfect Day is on a mission to create a kinder, greener tomorrow using precision fermentation. Leveraging expertise across biology, food innovation, and consumer products, Perfect Day empowers companies to develop, scale, and commercialize next-generation products that satisfy market demands and champion a path towards a more sustainable future.

**About the Department:** The Engineering Department supports site operations by maintaining the reliability, availability, safety, and efficiency of facility infrastructure, laboratory equipment, and utility systems. The team manages engineering projects, equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, and maintenance while ensuring compliance with applicable GLP, EHS, regulatory, and quality requirements.

**Corporate Services:** The Corporate Services Business Unit serves as the foundational infrastructure that enables the other three business units to drive Perfect Day's growth. These functions include Marketing, Communications, Finance, Legal, People & Culture, IT, Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S), Facilities, Lab Services, Capital and Strategic Projects.

**Position Summary:** The Manager/Senior Manager – Engineering is responsible for the effective management of engineering operations, including laboratory equipment, utilities, and facility infrastructure. The role leads maintenance and reliability activities, supports engineering projects and equipment lifecycle management, and ensures compliance with applicable GLP, EHS, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with R&D and cross-functional teams, the position enables safe, reliable, and efficient operations through sound engineering practices and continuous improvement.

**What You Will Do:**

· Develop and implement engineering and maintenance strategies, procedures, and plans to improve equipment reliability and operational performance.

· Oversee the operation and maintenance of laboratory equipment, including fermenters, bioreactors, autoclaves, biosafety cabinets, incubators, laboratory centrifuges, purification systems, cold rooms, and deep freezers.

·Oversee the operation and maintenance of utility systems, including HVAC Systems, chillers, Air compressors, Boiler.

· Oversee the operation and maintenance of CETP and RO plant.

* Maintaining compliance documents and submitting monthly/quarterly/annual forms to PCB/CEIG (As applicable)
* Managing HT & LT Power Distribution Panels.
* Overseeing operations and maintenance of UPS and DG

·Prepare, review, and monitor preventive maintenance schedules for laboratory instruments, utility systems, and facility equipment; ensure timely completion of routine checks and maintenance activities.

·Lead troubleshooting and breakdown resolution, coordinate with original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and service providers, and address recurring equipment issues to minimize downtime.

·Coordinate equipment installation, commissioning, calibration, and qualification activities, including preparation and review of relevant documentation (URS, FAT, SAT, DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ).

·Ensure timely documentation and closure of deviations, change controls, risk assessments, and CAPAs; coordinate engineering responses to internal and external audit observations.

· Manage external vendors and service providers for preventive maintenance, calibration, repairs, and other engineering services; coordinate effectively with R&D and other departments to support site operations.

· Promote safe working practices, environmental compliance, sustainability, and good housekeeping across engineering and facility operations.

· Identify and implement opportunities for equipment reliability improvement, resource optimization, and operational efficiency.

**What You Bring:** We are looking for a technically strong and proactive engineering professional who can manage site engineering operations, work effectively with cross-functional teams, and drive reliable and compliant facility support.

**Education, Experience & Other Requirements:**

· Diploma / B.Tech / BE Mechanical/Electrical and Electronics Engineering.

· 10–14 years of relevant experience, preferably in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (Must Have):**

· Practical knowledge of the installation, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of biotechnology or pharmaceutical laboratory equipment and utility systems.

· Working knowledge of equipment qualification and commissioning processes, including URS, FAT, SAT, DQ, IQ, OQ, and PQ.

· Knowledge of preventive, corrective, and reliability-based maintenance practices.

· Understanding of cleanroom requirements, applicable regulatory guidelines, and GLP/GMP documentation practices.

· Ability to review technical documents, maintenance records, qualification documents, and engineering procedures.

· Strong problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and manage vendors and service providers.

· Understanding of engineering key performance indicators (KPIs) and maintenance performance monitoring.

**Certifications, Licenses & Language Skills:** Fluency in Kannada and English, including reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Perfect Day is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
How to Apply

* Visit our careers page: counton.ai/careers/chief-of-staff-operations and apply for faster response

The role

R&D, service, production and sales at CountAI all move fast — and the most important work stalls between them. You run the company's daily execution rhythm: every morning you know what matters most, who owns it and what is blocking it. You clear blocks before they cost us a customer date, and you give top management one honest picture of where things stand and who is delivering. You work directly with the CEO and leadership to get the top-priority work done.

What you will do

* Run the morning meeting every day in 20 minutes or less: understand how each team's tasks flow and set their order of importance, so everyone works on what matters most.
* Keep one company priority list with owners, dates and dependencies. When priorities clash between teams, settle it — or take it to leadership the same day.
* Make sure no task is blocked anywhere in operations — R&D, service, production, purchase or sales. Find the block, name the owner, follow up until it is cleared.
* Track delivery by person — who commits, who delivers on time, and where people need help — and share it fairly with their managers as a monthly view.
* Give management a weekly overview: what moved, what slipped and why, the risks coming up, and the decisions needed.
* Turn leadership decisions into tracked actions, and close every loop.
* Build the tracking system itself — sheets, Jira or ClickUp, and AI tools — so it runs without chasing by email.

Who we are looking for

* 5–10 years in operations, production planning, a PMO or project management at an engineering, manufacturing or technology company.
* You have run daily or weekly review meetings with team leads — and people respected the follow-up.
* You understand both how a factory runs and how R&D works; you can tell an engineering delay from a purchase delay.
* Firm and fair: you can tell a senior engineer their task is late and still have their trust tomorrow.
* Organised and data-minded: your tracker is the one source everyone trusts. Comfortable with spreadsheets, project tools and AI assistants.
* Fluent in English and Tamil.
* An MBA, PMP or Scrum certification is a plus; your track record matters more.

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people, and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.

* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.

* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.

* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

**2. Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.

* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.

* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.

* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3. Technical & Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.

* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.

* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.

* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4. Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.

* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.

* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5. Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per unit targets.

* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.

* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6. Environment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.

* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

**7. People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.

* Drive skill development, succession planning, multi-skilling and a strong performance culture.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Production, Industrial, Polymer or Paper & Pulp Engineering. MBA or PG diploma in Operations Management is an advantage.

* Certifications (preferred): Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt, internal auditor for ISO standards, TPM.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 18–25 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 8–10 years in a senior plant or operations leadership role.

* Must have extensive, hands-on experience in sanitary pad manufacturing; experience in baby diapers, adult diapers or other medical / personal hygiene products is strongly preferred.

* Proven track record of running high-speed converting lines, commissioning new lines and managing multi-line plants.

* Experience managing large teams (200+) in a regulated, high-volume FMCG or healthcare manufacturing environment.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of absorbent hygiene product (AHP) processes: fluff pulp defibration, SAP dosing, core forming, lamination, embossing, ultrasonic and thermal bonding, adhesive application, cutting, folding, wrapping and packing.

* Familiarity with leading machine suppliers and technologies in the hygiene industry.

* Strong command of OEE, TPM, Lean, Six Sigma and data-driven problem solving.

* Sound understanding of GMP, quality systems, regulatory norms and audit readiness.

* Capex planning, vendor negotiation and project management ability.

* Excellent leadership, decision-making, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

jobs.title: ASSISTANT MANAGER – QUALITY ASSURANCE (3PL VENDOR)
jobs.description:
**Job Location:** Noida  
**Salary:** Up to ₹10 LPA  
**Experience:** 6–8+ Years  
**Position:** Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance  
**Industry:** Food / FMCG / Food Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance to oversee end-to-end quality assurance and food safety operations across third-party manufacturing facilities and 3PL vendors.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety compliance, vendor quality governance, process monitoring, and regulatory adherence. The role requires hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturers or co-packers, conducting quality audits, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and maintaining food safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Vendor Quality Management & Audits**

* Conduct periodic quality and food safety audits at third-party manufacturing and co-packer facilities.
* Ensure vendor compliance with FSSAI, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and GMP standards.
* Monitor vendor quality performance and ensure adherence to established quality standards.

**2. In-Process & Finished Product Quality**

* Monitor raw material, packaging material, and finished goods inspection processes at vendor locations.
* Review and approve batch release documentation, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and laboratory reports before dispatch.
* Ensure temperature compliance during product receiving, storage, and dispatch.

**3. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) for customer complaints, non-conformances, and audit observations.
* Manage product hold and release processes, scrap/rework activities, and mock recall exercises.
* Ensure timely closure of quality-related issues.

**4. Process & Hygiene Monitoring**

* Monitor Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), pest control, and sanitation programs.
* Oversee Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) validation and process control checks.
* Ensure food safety and hygiene standards are consistently maintained at third-party facilities.

**5. Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal R&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams, along with external vendor quality teams.
* Train vendor personnel on quality standards, food safety practices, and testing protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in vendor quality performance.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, or Biotechnology.
* 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within the Food, FMCG, or Contract Manufacturing industry.
* Hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturing units, vendors, or co-packers is essential.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000 and ISO 22000 standards.
* Experience in quality audits, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, and statistical quality tools.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good team management and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently to third-party manufacturing facilities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone with strong expertise in food safety, vendor quality management, and third-party manufacturing operations, who can independently drive quality standards and ensure regulatory compliance across multiple vendor facilities.

**Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes for consideration.**

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:** Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant (Tablets & Capsules, NPD)

**Engagement type:** Consultant, project-based

**Work location:** Chennai office (on-site)

**Domain:** Pharmaceutical drug formulation and new product development (oral solid dosage)

**Duration:** Project-based, to be defined at onboarding (extendable)

**1. Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Pharmaceutical Formulation Consultant to develop new tablet and capsule products. The consultant will work from our Chennai office for the project duration. The role covers hands-on formulation preparation along with market research that supports product selection and positioning.

**2. Eligibility**

* **Freshers are not eligible to apply.**
* **Minimum 3+ years of hands-on, practical experience in formulation** (lab-level preparation and trials for tablets and/or capsules).
* Candidates with only theoretical or academic exposure, or with experience limited to QC, QA, or regulatory work, will not be considered.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Formulation Development (Tablets & Capsules)**

* Design and develop oral solid dosage formulations (immediate-release, and modified or sustained-release where applicable) for new products.
* Conduct pre-formulation studies: API characterisation, solubility, compatibility, and excipient selection.
* Personally prepare lab-scale formulation trials and optimise them using QbD / DoE principles.
* Select the manufacturing process (direct compression, wet or dry granulation, capsule filling) and define critical process parameters.
* Evaluate and troubleshoot trial batches: hardness, friability, disintegration, dissolution, assay, and content uniformity.
* Run stability studies as per ICH guidelines and interpret the results.
* Prepare formulation documents: Master Formula, development reports, and technical data packages.
* Support scale-up and tech transfer to the manufacturing site.

**B. Market Research**

* Carry out market and competitor analysis for target molecules and dosage forms (market size, demand trends, key players, pricing).
* Identify new product opportunities, including generics, 505(b)(2), nutraceutical-pharma crossover, and niche or unmet-need segments.
* Review the patent landscape, exclusivity status, and reference listed drug (RLD) details.
* Assess the regulatory pathway and market-entry feasibility (India CDSCO and, where relevant, regulated markets).
* Prepare product feasibility reports and a recommended product pipeline with a go / no-go view.

**C. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate lab records and development documentation.
* Share regular progress updates and present findings to management.
* Deliver a final project report with formulation, data, and recommendations.

**4. Required Qualifications**

* M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics / Industrial Pharmacy) or Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences. B.Pharm with strong practical experience may be considered.
* **3+ years of practical formulation experience** in oral solid dosage forms (tablets and capsules).
* Demonstrated involvement in product development trials, from pre-formulation through optimisation.

**5. Required Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of excipients, granulation, compression, coating, and capsule-filling technologies.
* Hands-on use of formulation equipment (blenders, granulators, tablet press, capsule filling machine, coating pan).
* Knowledge of ICH, QbD, and cGMP, plus regulatory requirements for product filing.
* Familiarity with analytical methods: dissolution, HPLC, and related quality tests.
* Ability to conduct market research using IQVIA, patent databases, regulatory databases, and similar sources.
* Strong analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and deliver to timelines.

**6. Preferred**

* Experience with modified-release or complex generics.
* Exposure to regulated-market filings (US FDA, EMA, WHO-GMP).
* Prior consulting experience.

**7. Deliverables**

* Pre-formulation and feasibility reports
* Optimised tablet and capsule formulations with trial batch data
* Stability data summary
* Market research and product opportunity report
* Final technical and project report

**8. Terms**

* **Compensation:** Consultant fee (fixed or monthly retainer or Project Based feedback ), to be discussed
* **Reporting to:** Project Head
* **Work mode:** On-site at the Chennai office for the project duration

Language:

* Hindi (Preferred)
* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head PreClinical- Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology
jobs.description:
VENUS MEDICINE RESEARCH CENTRE (VMRC)

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Lead rodent and non-rodent infection models:
* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression
* Support herbal and metabolic programme evaluation

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

* Lead nephrotoxicity strategy for Renal Guard
* Integrate biomarkers, PK, and histopathology
* Interpret renal injury pathways and kidney drug disposition

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Oversee PK, tissue distribution, ELF/renal penetration, and permeability studies
* Lead NCA, compartmental and population PK analyses
* Conduct PTA and Monte Carlo simulations
* Support dose projection and breakpoint justification

Required tools:

* Phoenix WinNonlin
* NONMEM
* R or equivalent platforms

Toxicology & Safety

* Oversee acute/repeat-dose toxicity, safety pharmacology, TK, and local tolerance studies
* Interpret NOAEL, MTD, therapeutic index, and safety margins
* Ensure alignment with ICH and IND/CTA requirements

Regulatory & GLP

* Lead nonclinical regulatory submissions:
* CTD Modules 2.4, 2.6, 4
* FDA, EMA, CDSCO submissions
* Drive GLP compliance, SOP quality, QA readiness, and facility accreditation
* Support publications, scientific presentations, and regulatory interactions

Regulatory Knowledge (Non-Negotiable)

Strong working knowledge of:

* OECD GLP Principles
* ICH M3(R2), S-series, E6(R2)
* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Proven anti-infective or antimicrobial development experience
* Exposure to BL+BLI or combination products
* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset
* Demonstrated ability to build high-performing preclinical teams and infrastructure
