jobs.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
jobs.description:
About Company

House of Spices is a leading South Asian Food manufacturer and distributor in North America (USA & Canada) and has been delivering pure and quality products for over 50 years with 11 distribution centers throughout North America. We have our own brands and have exclusivity for distributing our partner brands in US / Canada. Our vision is to bring our culture alive through the celebration of authentic ethnic food, flavor and families. Our mission is to provide consumers easy access to all authentic ethnic food and flavors across the North American marketplace with a will to win. Visit www.hosindia.com to know more.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Summary/Objective:

The Supplier QA Executive will be primarily responsible for on-site production witnessing and supplier quality assurance for HOS products manufactured at supplier/co-packer facilities across South India.

The key responsibility is to ensure that every witnessed production is carried out as per approved HOS product specifications, formulations, process parameters, food-safety requirements, SOPs, GMP/GHP, sanitation requirements and applicable US FDA/FSMA requirements.

The position will have a strong shop-floor presence and will be responsible for identifying deviations during production, immediately communicating risks, ensuring containment, supporting root-cause analysis (RCA) and verifying effective implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).

This is primarily a field-based supplier QA role, not a documentation-focused position.

**Base Location: Vadodara**

Key Responsibilities

**Supplier Production Witnessing & Process Compliance**

* Regularly visit assigned suppliers and witness production to ensure products are manufactured as per approved HOS specifications, formulations, process parameters, SOPs, quality standards and applicable food-safety requirements. Verify actual production conditions and process controls rather than relying only on supplier documentation.

**Raw Material, Formulation & Product Specification Compliance**

* Verify the use of approved raw materials, ingredients and packaging materials and ensure formulation, processing, product characteristics, net weight and finished-product requirements comply with approved HOS specifications. Identify and escalate any unauthorized changes or deviations.

**Critical Process & Food Safety Control Verification**

* Verify implementation and monitoring of HACCP/Preventive Controls, CCPs, critical process parameters and other food-safety controls during production, with particular focus on
  **Frozen RTE and Rice processing**
  .

**Ready to eat products Quality Assurance:**

* Provide strong on-site quality oversight for Frozen RTE and Rice products, including cooking, cooling, freezing, hygiene, cross-contamination controls, temperature controls, foreign-material controls, destoning, grading, sortex, admixture, varietal authenticity and other product-specific requirements.

**GMP, Hygiene, Sanitation & Plant Verification**

* Conduct regular physical verification of supplier facilities for GMP/GHP, personnel hygiene, housekeeping, cleaning and sanitation, pest control, allergen control, foreign-material prevention, equipment condition, calibration and other prerequisite programs.

**Supplier Quality & Food Safety Audits**

* Conduct and support supplier/co-packer assessments and audits against HOS requirements, approved specifications, applicable regulatory requirements, GMP, HACCP/Preventive Controls, FSSC 22000/ISO 22000, BRC/customer requirements and other applicable standards.

**Deviation, Non-Conformance & Containment Management**

* Identify quality and food-safety deviations during production, ensure appropriate immediate containment and segregation of affected material, determine the scope of impact and communicate significant issues to the QA Manager before product release or shipment.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA)**

* Lead or support supplier investigations for production deviations, complaints and non-conformances and ensure effective RCA using appropriate tools such as
  **5 Why, Fishbone and process analysis**
  . Challenge incomplete or unsupported root causes and ensure the RCA addresses the actual cause of failure.

**CAPA Implementation & Effectiveness Verification**

* Review supplier CAPA, verify implementation at the supplier site and ensure corrective and preventive actions address the identified root cause. CAPA shall be closed only after objective evidence and, where required, follow-up production witnessing demonstrate effectiveness and prevention of recurrence.

**Complaint, Traceability & Supplier Performance Management**

* Support investigation of customer and internal complaints, verify batch/lot traceability, mock recalls, sample retention and relevant supplier records, and monitor supplier performance to identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities

**Reporting, Follow-Up & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare timely supplier visit and production-witnessing reports, document observations and objective evidence, track open actions and CAPA, follow up with suppliers until effective closure, and identify opportunities to improve supplier processes, quality performance and food-safety controls.

Travel

1. Travel is mandatory for this Job Profile

Required Education and Experience

1. A master’s or bachelor’s degree in food science/food technology or equivalent qualification.
2. Should have handled 3P operations
3. Knowledge of lab technique of analyzing different food product.
4. Good in MS word, excel, and power point.
5. Good organoleptic senses for product and sensory evaluation.
6. Lead Auditor (Any GFSI Scheme Certified PCQI Personnel Preferred.

**Preferred Knowledge**

1. Knowledge of lab technique and prior training in fundamental quality assurance technology.
2. Basic Knowledge of Quality Assurance; GFSI and Regulatory (US FDA); FSMA and other Regulatory standards.

4. Good communication skills.
5. Aptitude in problem-solving.

**Job Description – Strategy and Policy Division, Quality Council of India (Hiring for Policy, Legal, Tech and Marketing roles)**

**About the Team**

Strategy and Policy Division (SPD) of the QCI is a team of young professionals working towards augmenting the capacity of government bodies in policy making and formulating high-level strategies for projects that address national priorities. Our work at SPD entails numerous domains, which includes creation of a national level product label scheme, a flagship initiative of the Government of India. The team functions as a high-impact delivery unit within QCI, combining policy research, regulatory analysis, and project execution in a fast-paced, government-facing environment.

**Role Summary**

Your role will support the end-to-end operationalisation of various policies & schemes that QCI designs & implements. The support largely involves regulatory research, creating systems, SOP drafting to stakeholder coordination with regulators and industry associations. Depending on the experience, you would be designated as an Analyst, Associate Manager, or Project Manager (see Section 6). This role blends regulatory and standards domain knowledge with policy research, and scheme-level project management.

**Why This Role Is a Unique Opportunity**

This is not a typical corporate or consulting role. You will be at the centre of building India’s branding framework from the ground up – a programme with direct implications for achieving the goals of Atmanirbhar and Viksit Bharat. The work you do here will shape real policy outcomes.

We are looking for individuals who want to point to a national programme and say, “I helped build that.” If you have domain knowledge in manufacturing, standards, or trade policy, combined with intellectual rigour and a commitment to public service, this is the place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**There are 4 different roles (listed from A to D below) for which we are hiring multiple candidates-**

**A. Strategy & Policy**

* **Research & Synthesis:**
  Research BIS, FSSAI and international standards, testing procedures, QCOs, DGFT import-export regulations, HSN codes, rules of origin, NTBs and SPS rules, and turn findings into concise briefs and policy notes for QCI, DPIIT and other stakeholders.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:**
  Analyse sector-level manufacturing and trade data (production, import penetration, localisation, HS-code trade flows) for sector selection, threshold-setting and impact assessment, and present it through dashboards, leadership and ministerial decks, and research, benchmarking and progress reports.
* **Drafting & Documentation:**
  Draft Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, FAQs, proposal notes, inter-ministerial correspondence and approval documents in government format.
* **Stakeholder & Project Coordination:**
  Coordinate with BIS, BEE, DGFT, Department of Commerce, CII, FICCI, ASSOCHAM and Sector Council members; prepare agendas, minutes and trackers; and track scheme milestones (portal, sector onboarding, Sector Councils) with ministries and QCI leadership.

**B. Legal**

* **Legal Vetting & Drafting:**
  Draft and vet Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, Sector Addenda, undertakings, certificate holder terms, portal terms and privacy notices, MoUs and vendor contracts; prepare legal notes, opinions and file notings; and flag legal risk before any document is issued.
* **Enforcement, Disputes & Litigation:**
  Draft show-cause notices, suspension and cancellation orders, and grievance and appeal decisions in line with natural justice and SOP timelines. Manage challenges from notice to outcome: keep the court and limitation calendar, brief counsel, review pleadings, attend hearings, advise on appeals, and coordinate with the nodal Department where the Union of India is a party.
* **Law Firm & Panel Management:**
  Empanel law firms and counsel; allocate matters, fix scope and fees in work orders and check invoices; and hold firms to QCI’s standards on availability, forum coverage (Supreme Court to district courts, tribunals and consumer fora), conflicts and reporting.
* **IP & Brand Protection:**
  Protect the scheme’s name, logo and QR mark in India and abroad: trademark and certification mark filings, licence terms, register watch, oppositions, online takedowns, cease and desist notices and infringement actions.
* **Regulatory & Trade Law Research:**
  Interpret the BIS Act and QCOs, FSSAI, Legal Metrology, Foreign Trade Policy, customs and rules of origin, WTO and FTA obligations, trademark and GI law, the Consumer Protection Act and CCPA guidelines, and the DPDP and RTI Acts, and brief leadership at QCI and DPIIT.
* **Coordination, Records & Reporting:**
  Coordinate with DPIIT, BIS, DGFT, CCPA, law officers and industry bodies; maintain the Matter Register and precedent bank and feed lessons into SOPs; safeguard manufacturer data (including BOM and cost data); handle RTI and grievance responses; and report on open matters, risk and legal spend.

**C. Technology (Scheme Portal)**

* **Requirements, Design & Product Ownership:**
  Translate the Scheme Guidelines and SOPs into requirements, process flows, user stories and acceptance criteria for each portal module; own the backlog and release roadmap; and review the vendor’s UI/UX, architecture, data models and integrations so the portal is simple for MSMEs, bilingual, mobile-responsive and accessible.
* **Vendor & Delivery Management:**
  Support the RFP and bid evaluation; govern the vendor against plan, milestones and SLAs; assess change requests for scope, effort and cost; and verify deliverables before milestone payments.
* **Testing, Security & Go-Live:**
  Run UAT, triage defects and sign off releases; oversee go-live, data migration and rollback; and ensure CERT-In empanelled audits, compliance with GIGW, the DPDP Act, 2023 and hosting norms, and sound backups, disaster recovery, access control and audit trails.
* **Operations, Support & Reporting:**
  Monitor uptime, helpdesk and incidents against SLAs; secure documentation and knowledge transfer to avoid vendor lock-in; coordinate manuals and training; and define MIS dashboards for QCI and DPIIT.

**D. Marketing & IEC**

* **Marketing Strategy, Research & Campaign Planning:**
  Support the development of marketing and IEC strategies, campaign plans, audience segmentation, communication objectives and key messages, informed by market, audience and communication research and stakeholder feedback.
* **Brand Communication & Content Development:**
  Develop and coordinate clear, consistent communication materials such as brochures, presentations, FAQs, reports, infographics, videos, digital creatives and campaign content.
* **Digital Marketing, Monitoring & Reporting:**
  Coordinate digital outreach, social media content calendars, channel dissemination and audience engagement; track outreach coverage, participation, digital reach and engagement; and use these insights to refine communication and prepare periodic reports and recommendations.
* **Outreach, Events & Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Support awareness campaigns, workshops, conferences, trade fairs and outreach activities; coordinate with internal teams, industry bodies, partners and other stakeholders.
* **Agency & Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate briefs, deliverables, timelines and quality reviews with marketing, creative, media, event and IEC agencies or vendors.

**Required Capabilities**

We expect an ideal candidate to demonstrate the following capabilities:

Rapidly interpret standards, QCOs, BEE schedules, DGFT notifications and tariff schedules, using AI tools for faster research and drafting.

**High-Degree of Curiosity:**
Genuine interest in India’s manufacturing, trade and standards ecosystem and its policy developments.

jobs.description:
International Logistics Manager UK Operations  
**Company:** Greenwich Packaging  
**Location:** Mumbai Back Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Department:** International Logistics & Supply Chain  
About Greenwich Packaging  
Greenwich Packaging is a UK-focused packaging company supplying food, takeaway and customised packaging solutions to businesses across the UK. Our Mumbai office works closely with our UK operations, suppliers, shipping partners, warehouses and customers to ensure smooth movement of goods from origin to final delivery.  
We are looking for an experienced **Senior International Logistics Manager** to manage and coordinate the complete international logistics process from our Mumbai back office, with a strong focus on shipments into the UK.  
Key Responsibilities  
International Shipping & Freight Management  
 Manage the **end-to-end international shipping process** from supplier/port of origin to the UK warehouse and final customer delivery.  
 Have strong working knowledge of **international shipping terminology, procedures and documentation**.  
 Coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, shipping lines, agents and transport companies.  
 Obtain and compare freight quotations and negotiate competitive shipping rates.  
 Plan and coordinate **FCL/LCL shipments**, with a strong focus on containerised imports.  
 Understand shipping schedules, vessel movements, ETD/ETA, transhipments, free time, demurrage, detention and other key shipping parameters.  
 Track shipments and proactively identify and resolve delays or documentation issues.  
Container Booking & Documentation  
 Independently manage **container booking** with shipping lines/freight forwarders.  
 Coordinate with suppliers to ensure cargo is ready within required timelines.  
 Manage documentation including:  
 Commercial Invoice  
 Packing List  
 Bill of Lading  
 Certificate of Origin  
 Shipping Instructions  
 Import/export documentation  
 Container and shipment-related documentation  
 Verify shipping documents for accuracy before submission.  
 Coordinate with all relevant parties to ensure timely issuance of shipping documents.  
UK Import & Container Release  
 Coordinate with the **UK customs/clearance company** for smooth clearance of incoming shipments.  
 Provide and verify all documentation required for UK customs clearance.  
 Track customs clearance status and resolve documentation or clearance-related issues.  
 Coordinate the **release of containers at the UK destination port**.  
 Liaise with shipping lines, freight forwarders, customs agents and transporters for timely container release.  
 Monitor free time and proactively manage potential **demurrage and detention** exposure.  
 Ensure containers are moved from the port to the designated UK warehouse within the required timeline.  
UK Warehouse & Internal Logistics  
 Coordinate from the Mumbai office with the **UK warehouse team** for incoming containers.  
 Plan and coordinate container arrival and **unloading at the UK warehouse**.  
 Ensure warehouse teams have accurate shipment information and documentation before arrival.  
 Coordinate onward movement of goods from the UK warehouse.  
 Manage and coordinate **internal UK logistics and transportation**.  
 Arrange and monitor **last-mile deliveries** to customers across the UK.  
 Track delivery status and proactively resolve delivery issues.  
Coordination & Reporting  
 Act as the central point of coordination between the **Mumbai office, UK warehouse, suppliers, freight forwarders, customs clearance companies, shipping lines and UK transporters**.  
 Maintain accurate shipment trackers and logistics records.  
 Provide regular updates on shipment status, expected arrival dates, clearance and delivery timelines.  
 Monitor logistics costs, freight charges, port charges, customs-related costs, transportation costs and other associated expenses.  
 Prepare regular logistics reports for management.  
 Identify opportunities to reduce freight costs, improve shipment planning and minimise delays.  
Required Skills & Experience  
 **4+ years of experience in international logistics, shipping, freight forwarding or import/export operations.**  
 Strong practical knowledge of **international shipping procedures and terminology**.  
 Proven experience in **container booking and shipment management**.  
 Strong understanding of shipping and import documentation.  
 Experience coordinating with **UK customs clearance companies** is highly preferred.  
 Experience managing **UK warehouse logistics and domestic transportation** will be an advantage.  
 Strong understanding of the complete logistics cycle:  
**Supplier Container Booking Origin Documentation Port Vessel UK Port Customs Clearance Container Release UK Warehouse Unloading Last-Mile Delivery**  
 Excellent coordination and communication skills.  
 Strong follow-up and problem-solving ability.  
 Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.  
 Comfortable working with international suppliers and logistics partners.  
 Good knowledge of **MS Excel** and logistics tracking/reporting.  
Ideal Candidate  
The ideal candidate will be a **hands-on international logistics professional** who can independently manage a shipment from the point of container booking in India through to **customs clearance, container release, UK warehouse unloading and final customer delivery**.  
This is not a purely administrative role. The candidate must understand how international shipping actually works and be capable of **anticipating problems, following up with multiple stakeholders and ensuring that shipments move without unnecessary delays or costs**.  
The candidate will be based in **Mumbai** but will work closely with our UK operations on a daily basis.  
Key Competencies  
 International Shipping  
 Container Booking  
 Import/Export Documentation  
 Freight Forwarding  
 UK Customs Clearance Coordination  
 Container Release  
 UK Warehouse Coordination  
 Domestic UK Logistics  
 Last-Mile Delivery  
 Shipment Tracking  
 Freight Cost Management  
 Vendor & Transporter Management  
 Problem Solving & Follow-up  
**Location:** Mumbai Back Office  
**Experience:** 5+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Role:** Senior International Logistics Manager UK Operations

**Role & responsibilities**

1. Batch Manufacturing

* Execute batch manufacturing activities as per approved SOP& process instructions.
* Perform accurate raw material identification, verification, weighing/charging, pouring, mixing, heating, processing & packaging as per defined parameters.
* Ensure the correct sequence, quantity, temperature, time, mixing speed and other critical process parameters are followed.
* Ensure proper packing/filling in approved packaging materials such as jerry cans, AL/Coex bags, CFCs, etc.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO and material traceability requirements as applicable.
* Stop the process and immediately inform the Shift In-charge in case of any material mismatch, process deviation, equipment abnormality, or quality concern.

2. Quality & Food Safety

* Follow all requirements to ensure right-first-time batch manufacturing.
* Understand and comply with basic HACCP, CCP/OPRP, GMP, FDA, AIB and food safety requirements.
* Perform and record CCP/OPRP and other required process checks at the defined frequency.
* Maintain proper product and material identification to prevent mix-up, contamination and cross-contamination.
* Immediately report any quality, food safety or process deviation.

3. Material Management

* Coordinate with Warehouse for timely availability of required raw materials.
* Ensure all required RM is arranged in the designated bin/trolley before batch execution.
* Verify material name, code, batch/lot number, quantity and status before use.
* Ensure proper handling, storage and return of unused materials.

  

4. Cleaning, Sanitation & CIP

* Follow approved procedures for cleaning and sanitizing vessels, tanks, fillers, containers, utensils, equipment and production areas.
* Execute and monitor CIP processes as per defined SOP and parameters.
* Ensure cleaning records are completed accurately.
* Maintain required hygiene and prevent contamination during batch manufacturing.

5. Documentation & Compliance

* Complete BMR, CCP, pre-batch/pre-manufacturing checks, in-process checks and post-batch documentation accurately and on time.
* Ensure all entries are accurate, complete and traceable.
* Never make unauthorized corrections or backdated entries.
* Immediately communicate any documentation gap or process non-adherence to the Shift In-charge.

6. Safety

* Follow 100% safety compliance and use required PPE.
* Follow safe practices for handling chemicals, hot materials, equipment and moving materials.
* Report unsafe conditions, near misses, incidents and equipment abnormalities immediately.
* Do not operate equipment without required authorization/competency.

7. Equipment & Shop Floor

* Operate production equipment only after required training/qualification.
* Perform basic equipment checks before and during operation.
* Report abnormal equipment conditions and support TPM activities.
* Maintain 5S, housekeeping and visual management standards in the assigned area.

8. Material Handling

* Safely handle and move pallets, drums, bags and other materials using approved material-handling equipment.
* Follow manual handling requirements and safe lifting practices.
* Maintain proper identification and segregation of materials.

  
  
  

9. Teamwork & Communication

* Work closely with Shift In-charge, Section Head, Quality, Warehouse, Engineering and Planning to ensure smooth batch execution.
* Participate in shift handover and communicate pending activities, abnormalities and deviations.
* Support other team members as required while maintaining process discipline.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

02 years of experience in a manufacturing/food/FMCG environment preferred.

* Fresh Diploma candidates may also be considered based on competency and attitude.

**About the job**

**Job Title:** Plant & Commercial Chartered Accountant - Completed (Preferred) and Pursuing

**Location:** Corporate Office: Bhandup, Mumbai 400078

**Reporting To:** Head of Finance

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**CTC:** Competitive (Capped at 15,00,000/- per annum)

**Office Timings:**

* Monday to Friday: 09:30 Hrs to 18:30 Hrs
* 1st, 3rd, and 5th (if any) Saturdays: 09:30 Hrs to 13:30 Hrs

About the Organisations

* **AGT Foods India Pvt. Ltd.** is the Indian subsidiary of AGT Food and Ingredients Inc., an integrated agricultural processing and supply chain leader in pulses, grains, staple food commodities, and value-added food ingredients. Headquartered in Mumbai, AGT Foods India manages commodity procurement, import-export operations, trade financing, and high-volume distribution across regional and cross-border commercial trade corridors.
* **Umami Agro Industry Pvt. Ltd.** is the new production arm, establishing an integrated food processing facility at Khopoli, Raigad.

*(Corporate Websites: www.agtfoods.com*)

Role Summary

We are seeking an execution-oriented **Chartered Accountant (CA)** with 1–4 years of post-qualification experience in food processing, FMCG, or industrial discrete/process manufacturing.

This hybrid commercial and plant accounting role oversees end-to-end operational bookkeeping, inventory costing, multi-entity ledger reconciliations, and statutory compliance (GST/TDS) across both **AGT Foods India (corporate trading & commercial supply chains)** and **Umami Agro Industries (greenfield factory setup, pre-commissioning, and plant operations)**. The candidate will execute ground-level bookkeeping in **Microsoft Dynamics AX / D365** and Advanced Excel.

Role Clarification:

* **Current Operational Scope:**

      Hands-on transactional accounting and operational legwork across corporate and plant divisions.

      Daily execution of 3-way matching (PO vs. GRN vs. Invoice), vendor scrutiny, voucher entries, and physical inventory reconciliations.

      Setting up the Chart of Accounts, cost centres, project CAPEX ledgers, and trial balances for the new manufacturing facility.

**Not an Advisory Role:** Currently this is *not* a corporate statutory audit review, management consulting, investment banking, private equity valuation (DCF/NAV), or M&A desk profile. Future possibilities of including these responsibilities.

* **Future Strategic Evolution:**

      As the Khopoli plant transitions from setup to commercial scale, this role will evolve into commercial and financial leadership.

      Responsibilities will expand into plant-level MIS, OPEX/CAPEX variance management, supply chain working capital strategy, corporate direct/indirect tax planning, and liaison with statutory audit partners and lenders.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Core Bookkeeping, Multi-Entity AP/AR & Ledger Maintenance**

* Establish, align, and maintain the Chart of Accounts, cost centres, and voucher postings across AGT Foods India and Umami Agro Industries.
* Perform daily 3-way matching: verify Purchase Orders (PO), weighbridge / Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), and vendor tax invoices prior to booking.
* Manage end-to-end Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR), process scheduled vendor payment runs, and resolve supplier ledger disputes.
* Perform monthly bank reconciliations (BRS), inter-company trade/fund balance reconciliations, and general ledger scrutiny.

**2. Factory Project CAPEX, Manufacturing Costing & Inventory Accounting**

* Track raw grain intake, packaging materials, Work-in-Progress (WIP), finished stock, scrap, and process shrinkage/yield variances.
* Audit and record project CAPEX cash outflows, civil contractor milestone billings, machinery import documents, customs clearance costs, and fixed asset capitalization schedules.
* Conduct monthly and quarterly physical stock counts at the Isambe, Raigad factory site and regional storage warehouses; reconcile physical inventory with ERP balances.

**3. Direct & Indirect Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare, reconcile, and file statutory returns: **GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9) and TDS/TCS (24Q, 26Q)**[cite: 6, 7].
* Ensure compliance with Reverse Charge Mechanisms (RCM), E-Way bill generation, and input tax credit (ITC) matching (GSTR-2B vs. books of accounts).
* Prepare audit workpapers and coordinate with statutory and tax auditors for financial year-end finalization under Schedule III of the Companies Act[cite: 6, 7].

**4. ERP Operations & Advanced Financial Modelling**

* Oversee day-to-day transaction entries, journal balancing, master data hygiene, and batch runs within **Microsoft Dynamics AX / D365**.
* Build dynamic, formula-driven financial models in **Advanced Excel** (XLOOKUP, Pivot tables, Index-Match, dynamic arrays) for plant cash-flow tracking, daily trade position reporting, and raw material procurement costing.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

* **Professional Qualification:** Qualified **Chartered Accountant (CA)** registered with ICAI, 1–4 years of post-qualification experience
* **Industry Background:** Mandatory operational accounting background in **Food Processing, Agro-Commodities, FMCG, or Process/Discrete Manufacturing**.
* **Greenfield / Setup Exposure:** Prior experience participating in the accounting setup, Chart of Accounts formation, or pre-commissioning bookkeeping of a new plant, factory project, or subsidiary is strongly preferred.
* **ERP Experience:** Operational working knowledge of **Microsoft Dynamics AX (DAX) or Dynamics 365 (Finance & Operations)** is preferred; candidates with hands-on manufacturing experience in SAP (FICO) or similar enterprise ERPs will be considered.
* **Technical Skills:** High-level mastery of **Advanced MS Excel** for financial data cleanup and management reporting.
* **Work Location & Mobility:** Based primarily at the Bhandup, Mumbai corporate office, with flexibility for travel to the Umami Agro Industries factory site in Isambe, Raigad for physical inventory counts, asset audits, and operational accounting reviews.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Lead
jobs.description:
**About us**

Morulaa HealthTech is a Chennai-based, women-led medical device company and part of SaYog Group. We help global medical device manufacturers register, import and sell their products in India, and we act as their importer of record. We are now setting up overseas offices in Dubai and the USA. We need a senior QA/RA professional to own regulatory approvals and quality compliance across our growing portfolio of partner products.

**Role purpose**

The Lead - QA & RA owns the regulatory and quality function end to end. This covers registration strategy and submissions for new partner products in India and selected export markets, keeping our ISO 13485 quality management system audit-ready, and keeping products compliant through their lifecycle. The role works closely with overseas manufacturers, MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and our internal sales and operations teams.

**Key responsibilities**

**Regulatory affairs**

* Plan the regulatory strategy and registration roadmap for each new partner product, covering classification, pathway, timelines and documents needed.
* Prepare, review and submit registration, manufacturing and import licence applications under MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), and track them through to approval.
* Review and compile technical files, Device Master Files, Plant Master Files and STED documents received from overseas manufacturers. Identify gaps and drive remediation.
* Perform gap assessments against EU MDR 2017/745, including GSPR, clinical evaluation, PMS, labelling and IFU (including e-IFU).
* Respond to queries from MDLR licensing authorities, the US FDA, notified bodies and other regulators quickly and accurately.
* Lead US FDA submissions and compliance (510(k)/De Novo, establishment registration and listing, UDI, QMSR), and support other markets as Morulaa expands.
* Manage change notifications, licence renewals and post-approval changes for registered products.
* Track regulatory and standards updates and brief management and the team on what they mean for the business.

**Quality assurance**

* Own and maintain Morulaa's ISO 13485:2016 QMS, including procedures, document control, records and continual improvement.
* Plan and lead internal audits. Host external, customer and partner audits and close findings on time.
* Run complaint handling, non-conformance, CAPA and vigilance/field safety processes, and report adverse events to authorities as required.
* Oversee risk management files in line with ISO 14971.
* Review design and technical documentation (DHF, design verification/validation and labelling) against applicable standards such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-1-2, IEC 62366, IEC 62304 and ISO 20417/15223-1.
* Coordinate external testing (biocompatibility, sterilisation, electrical safety, calibration) with accredited labs.
* Conduct Management Review Meetings and report quality KPIs to the Directors.

**Leadership and collaboration**

* Lead, train and mentor QA/RA team members, and build the function as the business grows.
* Act as the regulatory point of contact for overseas manufacturers and partners.
* Work with sales, supply chain and finance so that products are imported, labelled and sold in full compliance.
* Run regular internal training on regulations, QMS and data integrity.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7-8 years' experience in medical device regulatory affairs and quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a lead or supervisory role.
* **Core experience must be with a medical device manufacturer.** **The candidate's foundation (typically the first 4-5 years) should be in an in-house QA/RA role at a medical device manufacturing company**, with direct exposure to the shop floor, production QMS, design control, CAPA and regulatory submissions for the company's own products. Later experience at a regulatory consultancy or IT/engineering services firm (e.g. HCL, TCS, Infosys) is acceptable. Profiles whose experience is entirely in consulting or services companies will not be considered.
* Strong hands-on experience with MDLR (Medical Devices Rules, 2017), including manufacturing and import licences, registration dossiers and query handling.
* Strong hands-on experience with US FDA submissions and requirements (510(k)/De Novo, 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, establishment registration and device listing, UDI, medical device reporting). Strong working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 14971.
* Proven track record of preparing technical files and obtaining product approvals or certifications (for example MDLR licences or FDA clearances).
* Experience with Class II/IIb/III devices.

**Preferred**

* Certified ISO 13485 Lead Auditor.
* Experience with FDA inspections, and with other stringent regulators such as EU MDR (notified bodies), Health Canada, TGA, PMDA or SFDA.
* Additional experience working with overseas manufacturers, or in an importer/distributor or regulatory consulting setting, after a manufacturing foundation.
* Product experience in one or more of these areas: patient monitoring accessories, respiratory devices, dialysis, IVF, cardiovascular or single-use sterile devices.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or similar training in problem-solving.
* Familiarity with PLM or SAP systems.

**Key skills and competencies**

* Regulatory strategy and submission planning
* Technical writing and document review with strong attention to detail
* Analytical, structured problem-solving
* Ability to manage several registrations and deadlines at once
* Clear written and verbal communication with regulators and international partners
* Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

**Key performance indicators**

* Registrations and licences obtained on schedule
* First-time-right submissions (few queries and rejections)
* Zero major non-conformities in external audits
* CAPAs and complaints closed within target timelines
* Licences and certificates renewed before expiry, with no lapses

**What we offer**

* A senior role building the QA/RA function at a growing, globally focused, women-led group
* Exposure to a wide range of international products and markets, including our Dubai and US expansion
* Competitive compensation in line with experience

**How to apply**

Send your CV to hr@morulaa.com with the subject line "Lead - QA & RA".

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided

* Leave encashment

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

As a world market leader in crop protection, we help farmers to counter these threats and ensure enough safe, nutritious, affordable food for all – while minimizing the use of land and other agricultural inputs.

Syngenta Crop Protection keeps plants safe from planting to harvesting. From the moment a seed is planted through to harvest, crops need to be protected from weeds, insects and diseases as well as droughts and floods, heat and cold.

**Job Summary:**   
The Certification Executive – Organic Compliance will be responsible for managing end-to-end organic certification activities across the manufacturing and processing facility. The role includes ensuring complete compliance with **NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations**, and other applicable standards from **raw material inward to finished goods dispatch**, including APEDA TraceNet operations, Transaction Certificate (TC) management, batch traceability, production compliance, documentation, and certification audits.

**Educational Qualification**

* B.Sc. Agriculture / M.Sc. Agriculture
* B.Tech Food Technology / M.Sc. Food Science
* Biotechnology / Microbiology
* Quality Assurance or equivalent qualification
* Additional certification in Organic Standards, HACCP, ISO 22000, Food Safety, or Internal Auditor will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 4–5 years of relevant experience in organic food processing, certification, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience in certified organic food manufacturing or processing units is mandatory.
* Experience in export-oriented food manufacturing will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Organic Certification Management**

* Ensure compliance with NPOP, USDA NOP, EU Organic Regulations, and customer-specific organic requirements.
* Coordinate with certification agencies for inspections, surveillance audits, renewals, and certification updates.

**5. Finished Goods Compliance**

* Verify finished product labeling as per organic regulations.
* Ensure packaging materials comply with certification requirements.

**6. Transaction Certificate (TC) Management**

* Generate inward and outward Transaction Certificates.
* Manage APEDA TraceNet transactions.
* Coordinate with certification bodies for TC issuance.

**7. Documentation & Record Management**

* Maintain certification documents and statutory records.

* Batch Manufacturing Records (BMR)

* Stock Registers
* Processing Records
* Yield Reports
* Traceability Records

**Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

 **Job Description**

**Role Purpose**

Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.
* Represent Analytical in cross-functional project teams, audits, technical reviews and customer/regulatory interactions where required.

**Key Interfaces**

Internal: Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality Assurance/Quality Control, Regulatory Affairs, HSE, Production & Supply Chain, Research, HR and Finance.  
External: Contract research/testing laboratories, equipment vendors, consultants, auditors and regulatory bodies.

 **Qualifications**  

* A PhD or Post Doc with specialization in Analytical Chemistry is preferred OR Organic chemistry or allied sciences qualification with high exposure to analytical and or formulation activity from a reputed institution in India or abroad. A 10+ years of experience analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams. OR
* Master’s degree in chemistry preferable analytical or allied Science, area from the reputed Universities with strong academic records and good communication skills Typically, 15+ years of relevant analytical laboratory experience, including 5+ years leading teams or technical workstreams.
* Deep practical experience with chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, e.g., HPLC/UPLC, GC, LC-MS/GC-MS, IC, UV-Vis, IR and particle/physical-characterisation techniques as relevant to the function.
* Demonstrated experience in analytical method lifecycle management, validation, transfer, stability/support testing, data review and investigation leadership.
* Experience working in a regulated quality environment (GLP etc.,) and leading stakeholder-facing technical projects.

**Essential Competencies**

* **Stakeholder management:** communicates with influence, builds trust and aligns diverse functional priorities.

We are on a strong path of growth, and you’ll get to be part of that journey — helping shape the systems, culture, and capabilities that will scale with us. **Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.

jobs.title: Senior Purchase Manager
jobs.description:
This role is to manage end-to-end procurement operations from pre-order planning to post-order follow-up ensuring cost-effective, timely, and compliant purchasing aligned with project needs. The role drives vendor coordination, inventory checks, cost analysis, and process improvements to support smooth project execution and organizational efficiency.

  

**1. Pre-Ordering**

a) Study Master Indent received from the planning department for technical specifications, approved makes, lead time, and pricing versus make. Highlight any discrepancies.

b) Involve the Project Manager to divide the Master Indent into planned dispatches.

c) Categorize indents into capital goods, tailor-made goods, ready-to-dispatch goods, and rate contract goods.

d) Allocate Purchase Assistants for specific projects.

e) Cross-verify the Master Indent with the stock register for available inventories and highlight them.

  

**2. Ordering**

a) Prepare guidelines for the procurement process and ensure timely execution.

b) Supervise staff for productive output.

c) Verify the Own Cost (OC) sheet received from the HOD and hand it over to Purchase Assistants.

d) Prepare cost estimates and manage the budget.

e) Send inquiries of capital items to vendors with proper specifications on time.

f) Review and evaluate the Cost Comparison Sheet prepared by subordinates after initial negotiation.

g) Negotiate with vendors for price, delivery, and payment terms. Update the cost comparison sheet accordingly.

h) Obtain approval from HOD on the cost comparison sheet and release purchase orders.

i) Follow up on GA drawings with vendors and ensure timely release of purchase orders.

j) Manage vendor payments and cash flow requirements.

k) Ensure timely delivery of procured items and arrange Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) for capital items.

  
  

**3. Post-Ordering**

a) Oversee inward and outward registers regularly.

b) Follow up with vendors for any shortages or rejected materials.

c) Arrange test certificates for supplied goods and maintain supplier databases and purchase records.

d) Certify purchase bills with proper documentation and coordinate material dispatch with the project manager.

e) Coordinate replacement or repairs for goods under warranty.

  

**4. Value Addition**

a) Develop and evaluate new vendors, prepare rate contracts, and maintain revisions.

b) Conduct ledger reconciliation for vendors regularly and ensure GST-R1 uploads.

c) Prepare suppliers' payment lists for approval.

d) Work closely with all departments and factories.

e) Review the delegation of work to the team, provide daily reporting to HOD, prepare MIS reports, and send them to higher management regularly.

f) Improve purchasing systems and processes and build and maintain good relations with suppliers.

g) Ensure compliance with laws, rules, and regulations.

  

**Educational Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Mechanical, Electrical or related field

  

**Experience:**

Minimum 15-18 years of experience in procurement and purchasing operations.

Experience in HVAC, cleanroom, MEP, pharmaceutical, or industrial projects preferred.

Strong experience in vendor management, procurement planning, and commercial negotiations.

Knowledge of ERP systems, inventory management, and procurement documentation.

Experience in handling project-based procurement activities.

Proven experience in procurement or purchasing roles, preferably in a managerial capacity.

Familiarity with sourcing strategies, vendor evaluation, and contract negotiation.

Experience in budget management and cost control.

Proficiency in MS Office and procurement software.

  

**Skills**:

Strong negotiation and vendor management & communication skills.

Knowledge of procurement lifecycle and supply chain processes.

Commercial awareness and cost control abilities.

Ability to manage multiple projects and procurement schedules.

Good analytical and decision-making capability.

Proficiency in ERP systems, MS Excel, Word, and procurement software.

Leadership and team management abilities.

Budget management and cost control.

Knowledge of procurement processes, regulations, and compliance.

jobs.description:

Manage applicable registrations, renewals, licences, and compliance requirements under relevant Central and State labour laws.

**Location:** Jabalpur/Bhopal/Borgaon/ Rewa  
**Reporting To:** Head – Quality Assurance / Senior Management

1. Job Purpose

To conduct regular quality audits across dairy plants, BMCs (Bulk Milk Cooling Centres), milk collection centres, and other operational locations to ensure compliance with quality standards, food safety regulations, hygiene practices, and company policies. The role involves extensive travelling, identifying quality gaps, preparing audit reports, and ensuring timely implementation of corrective and preventive actions.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Quality & Process Auditing**

* Conduct scheduled and surprise quality audits at dairy plants, BMCs, milk collection centres, and other company locations.
* Monitor milk procurement, reception, processing, pasteurization, chilling, storage, and dispatch processes.
* Verify adherence to approved SOPs, quality parameters, and operational standards.
* Inspect raw milk, processed milk, and finished dairy products for quality compliance.
* Check hygiene, sanitation, cleaning procedures, and CIP (Cleaning-in-Place) practices.
* Verify temperature monitoring, cold-chain management, and storage conditions.

**B. Food Safety & Regulatory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations and food safety requirements.
* Monitor GMP, GHP, HACCP, and other applicable food safety standards.
* Inspect employee hygiene, protective equipment, pest control, and sanitation arrangements.
* Verify quality records, laboratory registers, calibration records, and documentation.
* Identify deviations and non-compliance with statutory and internal quality standards.

**C. Laboratory & Quality Control Monitoring**

* Review laboratory testing procedures and quality control records.
* Verify testing of milk parameters such as Fat, SNF, CLR, Acidity, MBRT, and Adulteration.
* Check calibration and maintenance status of laboratory equipment.
* Ensure proper sampling, testing, recording, and reporting practices.

**D. Audit Reporting & Corrective Actions**

* Prepare detailed audit reports with observations, non-conformities, and supporting evidence.
* Classify audit findings based on their severity and operational impact.
* Recommend corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Follow up with concerned departments to ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Escalate critical quality issues to the reporting authority immediately.
* Maintain audit records, compliance trackers, and location-wise performance reports.

**E. Touring & Coordination**

* Travel regularly to different plants, BMCs, milk collection centres, and other operational locations.
* Prepare and follow a structured monthly audit tour plan.
* Coordinate with Plant Heads, Quality Teams, Production Teams, and Procurement Teams.

5. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong knowledge of dairy quality parameters and food safety standards.
* Good observation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to identify process deviations and quality risks.

Job Summary

The **Quality Control (QC) Officer** is responsible for ensuring that all raw materials, in-process goods, and finished products meet statutory food safety standards, internal quality specifications, and hygiene guidelines. This role involves performing routine physical, chemical, and microbiological testing, monitoring hygiene and sanitation on the production line, maintaining regulatory documentation, and preventing standard deviations during processing.

* **In-Process Quality Monitoring:** Conduct routine checks on production lines (e.g., temperature control, weight checks, seal integrity, moisture levels, pH, viscosity, and sensory evaluation).
* **Finished Product Testing:** Sample and test finished goods prior to release, verifying compliance with regulatory guidelines and customer requirements.
* **Laboratory Operations:** Perform standard chemical analysis (acid value, moisture content, peroxide value, brix, etc.) and collect samples for internal/external microbiological testing.

3. Compliance & Standards Management

* Monitor **Critical Control Points (CCPs)** and **Operational Prerequisite Programs (OPRPs)** on the shop floor.
* Log all non-conformances, initiate corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans, and isolate non-conforming products.

4. Documentation & Record Keeping

jobs.title: Hygiene Manager
jobs.description:
The Hygiene and Food Safety Manager is responsible for overseeing, maintaining, and enforcing the highest standards of food safety, sanitation, and personal hygiene across all restaurant kitchens, storage areas, service stations, and back-of-house operations. This role ensures full compliance with local health codes, regulatory bodies (such as FSSAI in India), and internal brand quality standards to protect guests and staff from foodborne risks.

Key Responsibilities

 Regulatory & Brand Compliance:

o Enforce local food safety laws, licensing codes, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

o Maintain Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) systems and keep comprehensive digital or physical safety logs.

 Auditing & Inspections:

o Conduct daily and weekly walk-through inspections of kitchens, prep lines, walk-in coolers, storage rooms, and waste disposal areas.

o Lead internal hygiene audits and prepare the team for surprise external health or government inspections.

 Training & Certification:

o Design and deliver mandatory food safety, personal hygiene, and safe handling training for all new hires and recurring refresher courses for existing staff.

o Ensure all food handlers maintain valid medical fitness certificates and required state/local food safety training accreditations (e.g., FSSAI / FOSTAC).

 Pest Control & Equipment Maintenance:

o Coordinate and monitor third-party pest control services, addressing any findings or recurrences immediately.

o Inspect kitchen equipment cleanliness and report mechanical or structural defects that compromise sanitation.

 Incident & Risk Management:

o Investigate any customer or staff complaints related to food quality, foreign objects, or illness.

o Identify high-risk operations (e.g., temperature danger zones, cross-contamination risks) and implement immediate corrective and preventive actions.

Qualifications & Requirements:

 Education:

o Bachelor’s degree or 2-year diploma in Food Science, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Environmental Health, or a related field.

 Certifications:

o Certified in HACCP, Good Hygiene Practices (GHPs), and local food safety authority certifications (e.g., FSSAI/FOSTAC).

 Experience:

o Minimum of 2–3 years of experience as a Hygiene Manager, Stewarding Manager, or Quality/Safety Supervisor in a restaurant group, commissary kitchen, or hotel F&B environment.

 Skills & Competencies:

o Strong knowledge of food safety legislation and sanitation audits.

o Exceptional attention to detail and observational skills.

o Clear communication and training delivery abilities.

o Ability to work in fast-paced, high-pressure kitchen environments.

* **Location:** Noida / Onsite
* **Department:** Product R&D / Design & Development

**About the Role:**

At Abley’s, we design sensory toys, weighted blankets, and adaptive clothing that empower children with special needs. We are looking for an innovative **Product Designer / Developer** to blend empathy, safety, and brilliant design to help kids thrive.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Product R&D & Conceptualization:** Research and design new sensory tools, weighted products, fine motor skill aids, adaptive clothing, and educational play essentials.
* **User-Centric & Safe Design:** Ensure all designs adhere strictly to child safety standards, child ergonomics, and non-toxic, BPA-free, hypoallergenic material requirements.
* **Therapeutic Collaboration:** Coordinate with occupational therapists, speech therapists, and child developmental experts to validate product utility and therapeutic outcomes.
* **Prototyping & Sampling:** Create initial sketches, 3D models (CAD), and physical prototypes of products; test them for durability, texture, sensory feedback, and weight distribution.
* **Material Sourcing & Vendor Management:** Source safe, high-quality, eco-friendly, and cost-effective fabrics, plastics, and filling materials. Coordinate with manufacturers and vendors for production scaling.
* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Manage products from initial idea/sketch to mass production, packaging design, and subsequent product iterations based on customer and therapist feedback.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Product Design, Industrial Design, Textile/Fashion Design (for adaptive clothing), or a related field.
* **Experience:** [0-4] years of experience in physical product design, toy design, consumer goods, or textile/apparel product development.

**“Passionate freshers equipped with strong foundational skills and creative portfolios are equally welcome.”**

* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in 3D modeling and CAD software (SolidWorks, Rhino, AutoCAD, or Blender) and Adobe Creative Suite.
* **Domain Knowledge:** A strong understanding of materials (textiles, food-grade silicones, plastics, non-toxic fillings) and manufacturing processes (molding, stitching, casting).
* **Empathy & Passion:** Deep interest or background in child development, ergonomic design, or accessibility/special needs products will be a major plus.
* **Communication:** Excellent coordination and problem-solving skills to work with cross-functional manufacturing and quality control teams.

**What We Offer:**

· **Ownership & Growth:** Opportunity to take complete ownership of products from scratch and grow rapidly alongside a visionary startup team.

· **Direct Impact:** Your designs will directly touch lives, helping children with sensory needs live more comfortable, confident, and joyful days.

· **Creative Freedom:** A vibrant, open culture where your ideas, experiments, and out-of-the-box designs are genuinely valued and executed.

· **Continuous Learning:** Work closely with cross-functional teams, industry experts, and child developmental specialists to expand your professional horizon.

jobs.title: Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with strong knowledge of machine design, Special Purpose Machines (SPM), New Product Development (NPD), 3D modelling, 2D drafting, engineering calculations and GD&T.

The candidate will be responsible for developing mechanical designs from concept to manufacturing, preparing detailed engineering drawings and coordinating with production, procurement and project teams.

Roles & Responsibilities

**1. Machine Design & SPM**

* Design and develop Special Purpose Machines (SPM) and industrial machinery.
* Develop machine concepts, mechanisms and complete mechanical assemblies.
* Prepare 3D models, assembly layouts and General Arrangement (GA) drawings.
* Select motors, gearboxes, bearings, couplings, shafts and other mechanical components.

**2. New Product Development (NPD)**

* Handle end-to-end product development from concept to final manufacturing.
* Develop innovative mechanical solutions based on customer requirements.
* Conduct design feasibility studies, design reviews and product validation.
* Implement design modifications and product improvements.

**3. Engineering Design Calculations**

* Perform design calculations for shafts, gears, bearings, keys, fasteners and structural components.
* Calculate torque, power, RPM, forces, stresses and factor of safety.
* Perform material selection and component sizing.
* Understand hydraulic and pneumatic system design.

**4. 3D Modelling & 2D Drafting**

* Create 3D parts, assemblies and layouts using SolidWorks.
* Prepare detailed 2D manufacturing, fabrication and assembly drawings.
* Generate BOMs, GA drawings and technical specifications.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of engineering drawings.

**5. GD&T & Drawing Standards**

* Apply GD&T as per ASME Y14.5 / applicable engineering standards.
* Define dimensional and geometric tolerances.
* Specify datums, fits, clearances and surface finish requirements.
* Review drawings for manufacturing feasibility and inspection requirements.

**6. Manufacturing & Production Coordination**

* Coordinate with fabrication, machining, assembly and production teams.
* Resolve design and manufacturing-related technical issues.
* Review vendor drawings and component specifications.
* Provide engineering support during machine assembly, testing and commissioning.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong proficiency in SolidWorks.
* Good knowledge of AutoCAD 2D drafting.
* Practical experience in industrial machine design and SPM.
* Knowledge of GD&T and engineering drawing standards.
* Strong understanding of mechanical design calculations.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, machining and fabrication.
* Experience in BOM preparation and engineering documentation.

Qualification & Experience

* **Education:** B.E. / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.
* **Experience:** 38 Years.
* **Software:** SolidWorks and AutoCAD.
* **Preferred Industry:** Industrial Machinery, Special Purpose Machines, Heavy Equipment, Mining Equipment, Recycling Machinery and Manufacturing Equipment.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong problem-solving and technical skills.
* Ability to independently handle mechanical design projects.
* Good coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to work from concept development to manufacturing.
* Responsible for timely completion of design and drawing deliverables.

jobs.description:
**NULO IS:**

We are the fastest-growing U.S. pet food specialty brand and have recently begun our European expansion with major retail listings across Italy, Spain and the UK. We were named “Top 25 Most Innovative Consumer Brands” by Forbes Magazine, offering industry-leading dog and cat food products with a world-class sales team, in a multi-billion-dollar industry that’s ripe for innovation and change. Imagine inspiring pet parents to think differently about the experience of feeding their dogs and cats, to feed them like the little athletes they are - with foods high in meat protein, low in carbs and infused with viable probiotics. To learn more visit www.nulo.co.uk

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

After entering the market in late 2025, Nulo is entering an exciting phase of European growth - building our presence across existing markets while preparing to expand into a number of major new markets from 2027 onwards.

As Brand Manager Europe, you will play a central role in building Nulo into a distinctive, relevant and commercially successful brand across Europe, with primary responsibility for the UK, Spain and other key markets. Working closely with the Head of Marketing, local Marketing Managers, as well as wider European and global brand/commercial teams, you will translate Nulo’s global brand strategy into key European growth markets, driving the short and long-term success of the brand in Europe.

This is a hands-on brand management role with ownership across annual brand planning, marketing campaigns, consumer insight, brand health, proposition development and commercial performance. You will be the guardian of Nulo’s brand positioning and distinctive assets, developing and delivering the brand strategies and activation plans needed to drive sustainable growth in each market.

Fluent English and Spanish are essential with additional European languages useful. Frequent European travel is expected.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**

* **Own the Annual Brand Marketing Plan –** working closely with the European Head of Marketing, create and deliver the annual marketing plan in key priority markets, aligned to commercial priorities and long-term brand strategy
* **Lead Consumer Communications –** adapt and deliver compelling, locally relevant communications across paid, owned and earned channels
* **Build & Optimise the Nulo Demand Generation Engine –** working with the wider marketing team, develop and own a full-funnel demand generation programme that drives brand awareness, consideration and trial to recruit consumers at scale
* **Develop Consumer & Category Insight** - build a deep understanding of consumers, category dynamics, competitors and emerging trends, converting insight into clear actions for the brand and portfolio.
* **Drive Brand Health & Performance** - track brand, category and commercial performance across priority markets, identifying growth opportunities and actions to improve awareness, consideration and trial, driving brand penetration and equity.
* **Shape Local Brand Positioning** - act as a guardian of Nulo’s positioning, distinctive assets and brand codes, ensuring global consistency is combined with local relevance
* **Portfolio Strategy & Innovation** - Lead on product lifecycle including performance analysis, opportunity identification, working with global teams on innovation and renovation
* **Lead Integrated Brand Campaign Development** - work with local & global teams and agency partners to develop and execute local campaigns.
* **360 Customer Planning** – lead development and execution of joint customer marketing plans.
* **Support Pricing & Portfolio Architecture** - partner with Commercial and Finance to inform pricing, pack architecture, promotional strategy and portfolio choices that support brand equity and profitable growth.
* **Brand P&L management** - manage and report on full brand P&L including managing brand investment, setting priorities and evaluating activity effectiveness
* **Agency & Partner Management** - lead relevant agency and specialist partner relationships, setting clear briefs and ensuring high-quality, on-brand delivery against timings and budgets.
* **Cross-functional Brand Leadership** - act as a key connector across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory and Global Teams to align priorities and deliver key initiatives

  

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

**Essential Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of brand management or marketing experience in FMCG, food, pet, or a related consumer-goods sector.
* Strong experience developing annual brand plans and translating consumer and commercial insight into clear growth strategies.
* Strong analytical capability with experience using consumer, category and commercial data to identify opportunities and measure performance.
* Commercial mindset with an understanding of pricing, promotional strategy, portfolio architecture and brand P&L drivers.
* Experience developing integrated campaigns and working across the full funnel
* Demonstrable experience working with key customers including joint business planning and shopper activations.
* Strong agency and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and influencing skills, with the ability to turn strategy into clear direction for others.
* Budget management experience and a strong focus on investment effectiveness.
* Fluent English and Spanish.

**Desirable Experience & Skills**

* Experience working across multiple European markets.
* Experience managing a portfolio, including innovation / NPD, renovation, proposition development and product launches.
* Experience within pet food, pet care, food, beverage or another premium FMCG category.
* Additional European languages are a plus.

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* **Brand Builder** - you care deeply about what makes brands distinctive and know how to build equity consistently over time.
* **Consumer Obsessed** - you are curious about people, culture and behaviour and use insight to inform brand strategy.
* **Commercially minded** – you are comfortable converting business objectives into marketing objectives and strategies
* **Analytical** - you are comfortable with data and use it to diagnose performance, challenge assumptions and make clear recommendations.
* **Hands-on** - you are equally comfortable shaping strategy, reviewing packaging, building a business case, briefing an agency and preparing a customer story.
* **Entrepreneurial** - you are a self-starter who thrives in a growing organisation where not every process or answer already exists.
* **Collaborative** - you build strong relationships across functions, markets and external partners
* **Fast & Pragmatic** - you maintain high standards without sacrificing pace of execution in the pursuit of perfection.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET:**

* Competitive salary and benefits, in line with the local market and experience.
* Full-time, permanent contract.
* Travel costs covered in line with company policy.

**Location**

This is a full-time, mostly remote position, with frequent European travel. We need this person to be willing to travel frequently around Europe.

**Salary Range:** €45K - €55K

We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality.
