jobs.title: Specialist Accounting (8 months Contract)
jobs.description:
**Purpose & Overall Relevance for the Organization:**

  

To maintain accurate, complete and timely accounting records for the UAE market through day-to-day accounting, retail sales and cash reconciliation, fixed asset accounting, prepayment accounting and landlord agreed-upon procedures reporting.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

  
* **Day-to-day accounting:** Perform routine accounting, journal preparation, account reconciliation, supporting-document review and month-end close activities for assigned areas.
  
* **Retail sales and cash reconciliation:** Reconcile daily retail sales recorded in retail systems and SAP against cash, card and other tender receipts; identify and follow up variances with stores, banks, payment service providers and relevant internal teams.
  
* **Retail exceptions and ageing:** Maintain visibility of unreconciled retail items, chargebacks, short/over banking and delayed settlements; perform root-cause analysis and drive closure within agreed timelines.
  
* **Fixed asset accounting:** Manage the end-to-end fixed asset process, including review of capital expenditure support, creation and maintenance of fixed asset cards, additions, transfers, capitalization, depreciation checks, disposals and retirements.
  
* **Fixed asset reconciliation and counts:** Reconcile the fixed asset register to the general ledger, investigate differences, coordinate periodic physical asset counts and maintain evidence of approved adjustments.
  
* **Prepayments:** Record and maintain prepayment schedules and ensure postings, release periods and monthly amortization agree to signed lease agreements, invoices and relevant supporting documents.
  
* **Lease-related support:** Work with Real Estate and business owners to obtain complete lease and contractual documentation and resolve discrepancies affecting accounting or landlord reporting.
  
* **KPMG agreed-upon procedures reporting:** Coordinate the AUP process with KPMG, including preparation of schedules, reconciliation of reported sales, collection of supporting evidence, response to queries and finalization of landlord reports.
  
* **Landlord submissions:** Ensure AUP reports and related landlord submissions are complete, accurate, appropriately reviewed and shared within contractual deadlines.
  
* **Month-end and audit support:** Prepare balance-sheet reconciliations, schedules and audit evidence; support internal and external audit requests and timely closure of observations.
  
* **Controls and compliance:** Follow adidas Group Finance policies, IFRS, UAE statutory requirements and internal controls. Escalate material, aged or recurring reconciliation differences promptly.
  
* **Process improvement:** Support simplification, standardization and automation of retail, fixed asset and prepayment accounting processes.
  

**Controlling:**

  
  

  
* Measure progress against own KPIs.
  
* Monitor all allocated reports and reconciliation ageing.
  
* Ensure adherence to Group accounting policies, procedures and internal controls.
  

**KPI's:**

  
  

  
* Daily retail sales and tender reconciliation accuracy and completion.
  
* Timely clearance of cash and settlement differences.
  
* Accuracy of the fixed asset register and completion of physical counts.
  
* Accuracy and timely release of prepayments.
  
* On-time preparation and submission of KPMG AUP reports to landlords.
  
* Quality and timeliness of month-end reconciliations and audit support.
  

**Key Relationships:**

  
  

  
* UAE Finance and Accounting
  
* Retail Operations and Store Management
  
* Treasury and Real Estate
  
* FP&A and Internal Controls
  
* KPMG, landlords, banks, payment service providers and external auditors
  

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

  
  

  
* Strong understanding of general ledger accounting, retail reconciliation, fixed assets and prepayments.
  
* Good knowledge of IFRS and financial control principles.
  
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail and the ability to investigate high-volume reconciliation differences.
  
* Ability to manage daily operational deadlines, month-end close, audits and contractual landlord reporting.
  
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.
  

**IT skills:**

  
  

  
* Outlook: intermediate
  
* Word: intermediate
  
* Excel: advanced
  
* PowerPoint: basic
  
* SAP: basic/intermediate experience is preferred.
  

**Language skills:**

  
  

  
* English: fluent written and verbal
  

**Requisite Education and Experience / Minimum Qualifications:**

  
  

  
* University degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or Business Administration.
  
* Minimum 2 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in retail, consumer goods or a multinational environment.
  
* Hands-on experience in account reconciliations and month-end closing; fixed asset and prepayment experience is strongly preferred.
  
* ACCA, CA, CPA or CMA qualification, or active progress toward one, is an advantage.
  
* Experience coordinating with key business stakeholders, audit or agreed-upon procedures requests is preferred.

The Research Technician’s main responsibilities are:

* Managing protocols and care for animal and plant research subjects
* Assisting the research team in the implementation of research projects
* Developing and managing complementary research projects
* Performing routine maintenance on facility, systems and equipment
* Providing work direction and training for technicians and student researchers
* Collecting, interpreting, describing and documenting data to support research activities

**Key Responsibilities**

**Management of cultures and care of research subjects and systems**

* Manages the routine operations of the marine ecology experimental facility, including systems maintenance, water exchange, cleaning tasks and technician schedule
* Manages the husbandry operations of animals/plants present in the laboratory (depending on project including reef fishes, corals, other invertebrates, and seagrass), including feeding and health monitoring
* Leads the breeding and larval rearing of tropical marine fishes and invertebrates for the marine ecology laboratory
* Develops and makes suggestions for improvements to the standard operating procedures (SOPs) and practices which promote high-quality operation of the facility
* Manages all records as required in the SOPs
* Liaises with appropriate teams to maintain health of the cultures, animals as well as the functioning of the systems to the level expected for the research projects

**Support of the research program**

* Assists the ecology team with the design, development, and maintenance of experimental set-ups as required by the research project methodologies and/or directed by the senior researcher
* Sets up and performs research experiments and procedures following prescribed protocol with autonomy (this may include weekend or night-time work
* Develops and manages complementary research projects
* Support with sample processing and data analysis
* Operates field, office, laboratory, and/or shop equipment used in support of research projects
* Collects, interprets, describes, and documents complex analytical and evaluative research data
* Manages data and databases
* Prepares reports, analyses, and basic models identifying progress and trends; makes recommendations or conclusions
* Provides technical aspects for a variety of research project components
* Provides technical training to visiting scientists and university students
* Assists research team with field work

**Management of the marine ecology laboratory and systems maintenance**

* Organizes and maintains and maintains aquarium systems, tools, equipment and grounds
* Monitors supply and equipment inventory to sustain day-to-day operations
* Assists with the maintenance of dry lab facilities (e.g., microscopes, spectrophotometer, Flowcam, nutrient analyzer).

**Support the Center’s activities**

* Supports the rescue operations when required
* Leads the research field operations when required
* Actively contributes to the outreach goals of the YSWRR
* Collaborates with SeaWorld Abu Dhabi Zoological and Education teams as required
* Contributes to the overall success of the YSWRR projects by performing all other duties as assigned

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Essential**

* Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., animal science, biology, microbiology, aquaculture)
* 4 years of experience as technician in a marine research or aquaculture facility or aquarium
* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
* Experience in marine ecological research in an aquarium and/or experimental setting
* Demonstrated competency in aquaculture operations including breeding, hatchery and larval rearing methodologies
* Good computer skills, including solid competencies using Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word
* Ability to represent the Yas SeaWorld Research and Rescue Center to community, media, government agencies, and conservation associations
* Excellent interpersonal skills and teamwork abilities
* Demonstrated commitment to company values and safety

**Desirable**

* Degree in Marine Ecology or Marine Biology
* 2 years of experience in a marine ecology research institute
* 2 years of experience with coral and/or seagrass husbandry.
* Arabic verbal and written communication skills
* Previous experience in the GCC region
* Evidence of ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary research teams
* Evidence of multicultural skills in the workplace is an advantage

At Miral Experiences, we don’t just create world-class destinations - we create unforgettable memories for our guests and remarkable careers for our people.

From theme parks and attractions to guest services and behind-the-scenes roles, every member of our team plays a part in delivering exceptional experiences. We’re driven by passion, powered by innovation, and committed to excellence in everything we do.

We’re looking for passionate, driven, and talented individuals who are ready to grow, lead, and make a difference. No matter your background or expertise, there's a place for you at Miral Experiences.

jobs.title: Quality Technologist

jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Home to some of the UAE’s best-loved brands, including Lacnor, Laban Up, Oasis, Milco and Safa, NFPC is looking for a
**Quality Technologist**
to join our Quality team.

**JOB PURPOSE**

The Quality Technologist ensures that Fresh and UHT products meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and regulatory compliance. They analyze product samples and run routine tests, including pH, conductivity, and the concentration of chemicals used, and they assess packaging materials. They also apply hygiene best practices across operations, carry out internal audits, and keep accurate quality records. Working within the quality team, they implement and maintain quality standards, procedures, and systems that meet UAE regulatory requirements and support consistent product quality.

**ESSENTIAL ACCOUNTABILITIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND KPIs**

**Testing & Analysis**

* Perform physical, chemical, and microbiological tests on raw milk, ingredients, and finished dairy products, including fat, protein, titratable acidity, pH, moisture, and microbiological counts.
* Carry out environmental and allergen swabbing to verify sanitation effectiveness.
* Test packaging integrity and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for corrective action.

**Process Control**

* Monitor critical control points (CCPs) and operational parameters across pasteurisation, fermentation, filling, and packaging. Make sure CCPs stay within defined limits and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for immediate corrective action.

**Raw & Packaging Materials**

* Inspect incoming raw and packaging materials in line with the company’s raw material receiving programme. Prepare summary reports on supplier ratings and material disposition.
* Take part in qualifying new ingredients, raw materials, and packaging materials, including machine runnability, stability testing, and pre-commercial and commercial trials.
* Lead the closure of packaging-related Non-Conformance Action Reports (NCARs), including reviewing and validating suppliers’ corrective and preventive actions.

**Compliance & Audits**

* Ensure compliance with HACCP, ISO, FSSC 22000, and other food safety and quality management systems.
* Implement Food Safety and Quality Assurance (FSQA) procedures across manufacturing and supply chain functions to reduce food safety risks.
* Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, and maintain accurate quality documentation.

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Dairy Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of quality assurance or quality control experience, preferably in dairy or juice manufacturing.
* HACCP Level 3 certification.
